  • callbackFlow, channelFlow та awaitClose
  • debounce, sample, distinctUntilChanged та take
  • Lifecycle-aware coroutines and Flow, flowWithLifecycle та Lifecycle Compose APIs
  • Testing Kotlin flows on Android та Android data layer guidance
StateFlow, SharedFlow, Channel та Android UI state/eventsрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після цього етапу ви маєте вміти відрізнити replaceable state від transient effect і durable outcome, пояснити точні контракти StateFlow, SharedFlow, Channel, stateIn/shareIn, обрати lifecycle та persistence boundary, знайти race/lost update і протестувати replay, buffer та subscriber timing. Тут не повторюються cold Flow basics зі Stage 9 або advanced operator composition зі Stage 11.

Senior mental model#

Спочатку класифікуйте інформацію, потім обирайте primitive. State відповідає “що істинне зараз?” і може бути відновлений новим UI. Effect — короткоживуча команда presentation layer, для якої треба явно прийняти втрату/повтор. Durable outcome — business fact із persisted identity, status та reconciliation; in-memory stream не робить його durable.

  • StateFlow — hot, conflated state holder із current value; SharedFlow — configurable hot broadcast; Channel — send/receive queue та ownership hand-off, не UI acknowledgement.
  • Hot object існує незалежно від collectors, але його producer lifetime визначає owner scope. UI lifecycle має керувати collection, а не lifetime business operation.
  • Навігація, snackbar і payment completion мають різну вагу. Жоден primitive сам не гарантує exactly-once user-visible handling через inactivity, recreation і process death.

Internals та contracts#

durable source / SavedStateHandle / repository
                 ↓ reducer (serialized or atomic transition)
MutableStateFlow<UiState> ── latest state ──► lifecycle-aware UI
                 │
                 └─ optional transient effect policy ─► SharedFlow or Channel

Cold upstream ── stateIn/shareIn(ownerScope, started, replay/initial) ──► subscribers

StateFlow: state, equality та atomic updates#

  • MutableStateFlow(initialValue) вимагає initial value; value читає current state синхронно. Це hot holder, який replay-ить latest value новому collector-у.
  • Updates conflated через Any.equals: equal assignment не emit-иться, а slow collector може пропустити швидкі intermediate values і побачити latest. Тому StateFlow не event queue; broken/mutable equality робить behavior unspecified.
  • value, methods та atomic helpers thread-safe. Для read-modify-write використовуйте update, updateAndGet або getAndUpdate; lambda може виконатися кілька разів при contention, отже без side effects.
  • _state.value = _state.value.copy(count = _state.value.count + 1) має lost-update race між concurrent writers. Atomic update вирішує transition одного holder-а, але не multi-store transaction або external side effect.
  • collect StateFlow ніколи нормально не завершується; failure/completion треба materialize у state. Експозьте asStateFlow(), не mutable producer.

SharedFlow: replay, buffer та subscribers#

  • MutableSharedFlow(replay, extraBufferCapacity, onBufferOverflow) broadcast-ить кожне accepted value усім active subscribers. Replay cache дає останні replay values новим collectors; extra capacity підтримує lagging active subscribers.
  • Non-default onBufferOverflow дозволений лише коли replay + extraBufferCapacity > 0. Overflow можливий лише за наявності slow subscriber; без subscribers зберігається тільки replay cache, overflow policy не спрацьовує, а extra capacity не накопичує backlog.
  • emit може suspend лише з SUSPEND і active slow subscribers. tryEmit non-suspending та може повернути false лише в такій ситуації. У unbuffered flow без subscribers tryEmit повертає true, але value одразу губиться.
  • subscriptionCount — StateFlow active collector count для resource policy, не acknowledgement конкретної події. Check-then-emit через count race-ить із subscription changes.
  • resetReplayCache() experimental: очищає replay для future subscribers, але current subscribers зберігають buffered values; це не erase, transaction або durable deletion.
  • SharedFlow ніколи нормально не завершується і не представляє failure сам: completion/error потрібно materialize. Replay — memory cache, не durable storage.

stateIn, shareIn та SharingStarted#

  • stateIn перетворює cold upstream на shared StateFlow з initial/latest value; shareIn — на SharedFlow із заданим replay. Sharing coroutine належить переданому scope, тому scope має відповідати lifetime даних.
  • Eagerly starts immediately; values beyond replay можуть бути втрачені до subscribers. Lazily starts on first subscriber and never stops. WhileSubscribed starts/stops із subscribers, тому upstream може restart-нути і повторити I/O або side effects.
  • WhileSubscribed(stopTimeoutMillis, replayExpirationMillis) може відкласти stop і reset cache; expiration resets shareIn replay cache або stateIn до original initial value. Defaults/version-specific overloads треба перевіряти у resolved API.
  • Normal upstream completion не завершує subscribers; sharing coroutine живе за strategy і може restart-нути з WhileSubscribed. Upstream exception terminates sharing coroutine та обробляється owner scope, не автоматично collectors; materialize/catch/retry до boundary за contract.

Channel та Channel-to-Flow boundaries#

CapacitySemanticsRisk
RENDEZVOUSZero buffer; send meets receive.Sender suspension couples lifetimes.
BUFFEREDDefault-sized buffer determined by library/configuration.Do not encode business guarantees from its size.
CONFLATEDAt most latest element, older values lost.Wrong for non-replaceable work.
UNLIMITEDSender does not suspend for capacity.Unbounded memory under a stalled receiver.
  • send suspends as capacity requires; trySend returns ChannelResult; receive suspends for an element. Always inspect failed non-suspending operations.
  • close stops new sends and lets buffered elements drain; normal close eventually ends receive. cancel removes remaining elements and cancels waiters. Producer/consumer ownership must say who closes or cancels and why.
  • A channel element is received by one receiver. Multiple receivers compete (fan-out/work distribution), while one receiver gives single-consumer ordering. It is not broadcast.
  • Prompt cancellation creates a hand-off caveat: cancellation can occur after an element was obtained but before caller processes it. onUndeliveredElement supports synchronous resource cleanup, not business exactly-once.
  • receiveAsFlow() supports multiple collectors competing for elements; collector failure does not cancel source channel. consumeAsFlow() is single-collection and consumes/cancels source on collector failure. Neither turns receipt into handled UI effect.

Guarantees vs non-guarantees#

GuaranteeNon-guarantee
StateFlow has current value, required initial state, equality conflation and thread-safe atomic update APIs.It records every transition, queues events, completes, or persists across process death.
SharedFlow broadcasts accepted values under configured replay/buffer policy.It represents completion/failure, replay is durable storage, or inactive collectors receive replay=0 events.
Channel defines queue, capacity, close/cancel and receive ownership.Delivery equals UI handling, cancellation cannot lose hand-off, or memory survives process death.
Lifecycle APIs stop/restart collection at the UI boundary.They make transient effects exactly once or prevent WhileSubscribed upstream restart.
Persistence plus IDs/acknowledgement can support retry/reconciliation.No primitive alone guarantees exactly-once user-visible handling.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • Pin one kotlinx-coroutines family and inspect signatures: resetReplayCache is experimental, Duration/millisecond WhileSubscribed overloads and annotations vary by release.
  • Channel.BUFFERED capacity can be changed by JVM property; never depend on remembered numeric defaults. Prompt-cancellation and onUndeliveredElement behavior belongs to the resolved library contract.
  • collectAsStateWithLifecycle lives in AndroidX lifecycle-runtime-compose; overloads/platform support and default lifecycle state depend on the resolved version.
  • SavedStateHandle supports Bundle-compatible, size-bounded restoration semantics, not arbitrary durable business storage; API integrations differ by AndroidX version.

Decision matrix#

NeedPrimary modelRequired policy
Renderable latest screen stateImmutable StateFlow<UiState>Initial value, reducer, equality, lifecycle collection.
Replaceable shared signal/tickSharedFlowReplay/buffer/overflow and subscriber absence explicitly accepted.
In-memory work hand-off to one consumerChannelCapacity, ownership, close/cancel, undelivered policy.
Expensive cold source shared in owner scopestateIn/shareInScope, start strategy, replay expiration, restart/error policy.
Payment/order completionPersisted operation/result as source of truthStable ID, idempotency, status query, acknowledgement/reconciliation; UI derives state.

Trade-offs і failure modes#

  • One-off event wrapper in state може replay-нути вже “consumed” event іншому collector-у або втратити його через consume race; mutable consumed flags також ламають immutable state.
  • SharedFlow(replay=0) не доставить inactive UI; replay=1 може повторити stale navigation/snackbar після recreation і дати її кожному collector-у.
  • Channel може зберегти effect під час короткої UI inactivity у ViewModel lifetime, але competing collectors ділять events, recreation timing race-ить, а process death стирає queue. Receive не означає, що snackbar/navigation реально показані.
  • Моделювання transient effect як state робить replay/recovery можливим, але потрібен idempotent acknowledgement/clear transition; state conflation може suppress equal повтор.
  • Mutable object/list in StateFlow може бути changed in place без new unequal value; Compose не має надійної immutable snapshot boundary. Emit immutable copies.
  • WhileSubscribed economizes resources, але stop/restart churn може duplicate expensive setup; виберіть timeout і idempotent upstream.

Production scenario: checkout outcome, navigation та snackbar#

Гіпотетично: checkout ViewModel reducer оновлює immutable CheckoutUiState через update. Form/loading/errors, які мають пережити recreation, є state. Draft ID і мінімальний restorable input можуть бути в SavedStateHandle; cart, payment operation та completion persisted у repository/database/server. stateIn(viewModelScope, WhileSubscribed(...), initial) має explicit restart/error policy.

Успішна оплата — не ephemeral “navigate now”. Repository записує operation ID/status; UI state показує completion, а navigation виконується як idempotent presentation reaction із destination/handled key, після чого acknowledgement оновлює state. Snackbar для неважливої підказки може бути best-effort SharedFlow із documented loss; actionable error краще залишається state до user action. Це не exactly-once claim: crash можливий між display і acknowledgement, тому critical outcome reconciles from durable truth.

private val _state = MutableStateFlow(CheckoutUiState())
val state = _state.asStateFlow()
private val _effects = MutableSharedFlow<UiEffect>(
    replay = 0, extraBufferCapacity = 1, onBufferOverflow = BufferOverflow.DROP_OLDEST
)

fun quantityChanged(delta: Int) {
    _state.update { old -> old.copy(quantity = old.quantity + delta) }
}

// Best-effort only; payment completion is persisted and reduced into state.
fun hint(text: String) { _effects.tryEmit(UiEffect.Snackbar(text)) }

Code-review/debugging trap#

_state.value = _state.value.copy(count = _state.value.count + 1) // lost update
_events.emit(NavigateToReceipt)                                  // replay=0; no collector
if (_events.subscriptionCount.value > 0) _events.emit(effect)     // check/emit race
val effects = Channel<UiEffect>(Channel.UNLIMITED)                // hidden memory growth
orders.stateIn(GlobalScope)                                       // wrong lifetime/defaults

Review має вимагати atomic reducer, explicit scope/start/replay/buffer/overflow, read-only exposure, immutable state, lifecycle collection і durable boundary. Debugуйте producer scope, subscriber count transitions, replay cache, buffer result, collector identity/lifecycle, operation IDs та timestamps. Не “виправляйте” race збільшенням buffer без delivery requirement.

Testing timing, replay та concurrency#

  • У runTest запускайте collector до emission коли contract це вимагає; hot flow не зберігає все автоматично. Використовуйте backgroundScope, runCurrent, advanceTimeBy/advanceUntilIdle і shared scheduler.
  • StateFlow: assert initial/current value, equal suppression, slow collector conflation та concurrent update; не очікуйте кожен intermediate value.
  • SharedFlow: matrix before/after subscribe, zero/multiple subscribers, replay 0/N, buffer full, each overflow mode, emit suspension, tryEmit result, reset replay for future collector.
  • stateIn/shareIn: count upstream starts/stops, test stop timeout and replay expiration around exact virtual-time boundaries, assert WhileSubscribed restart and scope cancellation.
  • Channel: each capacity, competing receivers, close versus cancel, failed send/receive and onUndeliveredElement. Add lifecycle/recreation/process-restoration integration tests and real-thread stress tests; virtual time is not a proof of thread ordering.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. Чому StateFlow підходить для UI state? Він має initial/current value, replay latest, equality conflation і thread-safe updates; UI може render-ити snapshot. Це не event queue.
  2. Чому value++-style update небезпечний? Read-modify-write не atomic. Використовуйте update/updateAndGet/getAndUpdate з side-effect-free lambda.
  3. Що зберігає SharedFlow без subscribers? Лише replay cache; extra buffer та overflow policy не створюють offline queue. tryEmit може succeed, а value бути discarded.
  4. emit чи tryEmit? Emit може suspend за SUSPEND/slow-subscriber policy; tryEmit повертає result одразу. Success означає acceptance за contract, не UI handling.
  5. Коли WhileSubscribed restart-ить upstream? Після stop через відсутність subscribers нова subscription запускає його знову; side effects мають бути safe, а replay expiration explicit.
  6. Channel чи SharedFlow? Channel розподіляє кожен item одному receiver-у; SharedFlow broadcast-ить active subscribers. Обидва in-memory та не дають UI exactly-once.
  7. Чим receiveAsFlow відрізняється від consumeAsFlow? Перший допускає competing collectors і не consumes source on collector failure; другий collect-иться один раз і consumes/cancels source.
  8. Як моделювати navigation/snackbar? За вимогою: best-effort hint може бути transient effect; необхідний next screen/action — state з idempotent handling/ack. Документуйте loss/replay, не обіцяйте exactly-once.
  9. Як моделювати payment completion? Persist operation ID/status, make server action idempotent, reconcile and derive UI state. Channel/SharedFlow може лише сигналізувати refresh.
  10. Як collect-ити в Android UI? Views — repeatOnLifecycle; Compose state — collectAsStateWithLifecycle. Immutable state sets recomposition boundary; lifecycle restart не відновлює in-memory effects.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Два collectors отримали ту саму navigation effect. SharedFlow is broadcast. Якщо дія належить одному UI owner-у, enforce ownership/idempotent destination state; не покладайтеся на race між collectors.
  2. Equal snackbar text двічі. StateFlow suppresses equal values; event wrapper does not fix durability. Додайте identity/state acknowledgement або прийміть best-effort SharedFlow policy.
  3. Upstream repeatedly reconnects on rotation. Audit owner scope, lifecycle subscribers, WhileSubscribed timeout та restart semantics; make setup idempotent and test start count.
  4. Channel send succeeded, але UI не навігувалась. Receipt and handling are separate; cancellation/crash can happen between them. Critical navigation derives from durable/idempotent state and reconciles.

5 self-check без відповідей#

  1. Що у вашій моделі є current state, transient presentation effect і durable business outcome?
  2. Що відбувається з emission без subscribers, зі slow subscriber і при buffer overflow?
  3. Хто володіє sharing/channel scope, close/cancel та upstream restart?
  4. Які transitions atomic, а які потребують transaction/idempotency поза StateFlow?
  5. Що відновиться після recreation та process death, і як UI acknowledgement reconciles?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do you choose among StateFlow, SharedFlow, Channel, and durable UI state?

~30-second answer#

I classify the data first. StateFlow is for a current, replaceable value: it needs an initial value, exposes the latest value, conflates by equality, and should be updated atomically. SharedFlow is a configurable broadcast with replay and buffer policy, while Channel is a one-receiver hand-off queue. None is durable and none means the UI handled an effect. I collect state with the Android lifecycle, expose immutable state, and model critical outcomes such as payment completion in persisted state with identity and reconciliation rather than claiming exactly-once navigation.

~2-minute answer#

I start with semantics, not the API. Renderable UI state answers what is true now, so I expose an immutable StateFlow from a ViewModel. It has a required initial and current value, equality-based conflation, and never completes normally. Concurrent read-modify-write must use update, updateAndGet, or getAndUpdate; the lambda is side-effect free because it can be retried.

SharedFlow is hot broadcast. I specify replay, extra capacity, overflow, and behavior with no subscribers. Extra capacity is not an offline queue; without subscribers only replay is retained. emit can suspend for slow subscribers, while tryEmit reports immediate acceptance, not UI handling. Channel gives queue and one-receiver ownership with explicit capacity, close, cancellation, and undelivered-element policy. Multiple receivers compete. receiveAsFlow preserves that fan-out; consumeAsFlow is single-use and consumes the source.

For cold-source sharing, stateIn and shareIn belong to an owner scope. Eagerly, Lazily, and WhileSubscribed differ in start and stop lifetime. WhileSubscribed can stop, reset replay after expiration, and restart upstream, so setup and effects must tolerate restarts. Upstream errors need an explicit policy before the sharing boundary.

On Android, repeatOnLifecycle and collectAsStateWithLifecycle define collection boundaries, not delivery guarantees. Compose receives immutable snapshots and recomposes readers. A snackbar may be documented best effort, navigation should usually be idempotent state-driven when it matters, and payment completion must be persisted with an operation ID, status, acknowledgement, and reconciliation. SavedStateHandle restores small UI/process state, not durable business truth. Tests place subscribers before and after emissions, fill buffers, advance virtual time around sharing timeouts, race atomic updates, and verify recreation and process-restoration behavior. No primitive alone provides exactly-once user-visible handling.

Advanced Kotlin Flow у productionрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після етапу ви маєте проєктувати production Flow topology: обирати timing/order/completion semantics для composition і flattening, будувати latest-wins search без stale state, локалізувати failure/retry, володіти sharing lifecycle/cache boundary, інтегрувати callbacks та доводити timing, cancellation, retry і sharing детермінованими тестами. Stage 9 basics і Stage 10 primitives тут згадуються лише для порівняння.

Senior mental model#

Flow topology — це executable policy. Для кожної стрілки назвіть ownership, ordering, concurrency, buffering, cancellation, failure, restart і durability. Оператор не виправляє неправильний business contract: latest-wins, all-results, paired-results і durable work — різні задачі.

  • Cold chain виконується per collector; hot boundary переносить execution у owner scope. Lifecycle collector і producer lifecycle — окремі рішення.
  • Cancellation — control flow, не rollback. latest-оператори скасовують cooperative роботу, але не можуть відкликати вже відправлений HTTP request, commit у БД або інший external side effect.
  • Errors або завершують stream, або materialize-яться як typed domain value. Вибір має бути явним на layer boundary.

Internals та operator topology#

source(s) → admission/rate policy → composition/flattening → error policy
          → context/buffer boundary → domain state → stateIn/shareIn(owner scope)
          → repeatOnLifecycle collector → render

Each async/buffer/share boundary can change lifetime, ordering, backpressure,
exception propagation, memory use, and duplicate-side-effect risk.

map/filter are normally sequential in the collector coroutine. Operators such as buffer, flowOn, flattening, channelFlow and hot sharing introduce queues or coroutines. Read the chain left-to-right for data and right-to-left for cancellation/error effects; then mark every external effect.

combine vs zip vs merge; flattening та latest transforms#

OperatorTiming/orderCompletion/failure
combineПісля initial barrier emit-ить transform із latest value кожного input при наступній зміні будь-якого input.combine чекає перше значення від кожного input; input без initial emission може залишити UI у loading. Failure скасовує composition; completion одного input залишає його latest value, доки інші можуть emit-ити.
zipPairs n-th з n-th; faster side чекає/буферизується за contract, зайві unmatched values не формують pair.Завершується, коли один flow завершився і більше pair неможливий, та скасовує remaining collection; failure propagates.
mergeCollect-ить inputs concurrently та emit-ить як готові; між inputs order не гарантується.Нормально завершується після всіх inputs; failure за structured concurrency завершує merge і скасовує siblings, якщо його не materialize до merge.
  • flatMapConcat collect-ить inner flows послідовно і зберігає outer order, але slow inner створює head-of-line blocking.
  • flatMapMerge(concurrency = n) collect-ить до n inner flows concurrently; output order залежить від completion/emission timing. Limit — ресурсна політика, не rate limiter і не business ordering.
  • flatMapLatest скасовує previous inner flow при новому outer value. mapLatest скасовує попередній transform; transformLatest може emit-ити кілька values і скасовує весь попередній transform block. Latest cancellation cooperative.
  • Якщо потрібні всі результати — latest wrong; якщо потрібен лише current query — concat/merge можуть показати stale output. Naming має виражати policy.

Search pipeline: latest cancellation і stale-result protection#

val results: StateFlow<SearchUiState> = query
    .map(String::trim)
    .debounce(300)
    .distinctUntilChanged()
    .flatMapLatest { q ->
        if (q.length < 2) flowOf(SearchUiState.Idle)
        else flow {
            emit(SearchUiState.Loading(q))
            emit(SearchUiState.Content(q, repository.search(q)))
        }.catch { e ->
            if (e is CancellationException) throw e
            emit(SearchUiState.Error(q, e.toDomainError()))
        }
    }
    .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), SearchUiState.Idle)
  • debounce controls quiet-time admission; distinctUntilChanged removes adjacent equal normalized queries; neither is a cache.
  • flatMapLatest prevents an older cooperative inner flow from emitting after a newer query. For non-cooperative/uncancellable APIs or separately launched work, add a request generation/query key at reducer boundary and reject mismatched results.
  • Cancellation cannot undo server mutation. Search should be read-only/idempotent; writes need idempotency keys and reconciliation rather than latest-wins.

Multi-source UI state та initial-emission traps#

  • Use combine for latest account + local rows + filter when any source should re-render. Model loading/absent/error explicitly; do not use a magic empty list as “not loaded”.
  • A callback flow that emits only on change, a filtered source, or a SharedFlow(replay=0) may never provide the first value, so combine emits nothing. Seed only when a truthful initial state exists (onStart, StateFlow, database snapshot), not to silence a test.
  • Combining many independent fields can expose cross-source snapshots, not an atomic transaction. If consistency matters, read a database transaction/snapshot or combine a single versioned aggregate.
  • One failing source terminates the combined chain by default. Materialize recoverable per-source errors before combine when partial UI is a requirement; otherwise fail the aggregate deliberately.

Exception transparency, completion та retry boundaries#

  • catch handles exceptions from operators upstream of it and is transparent to cancellation; catch не ловить failures downstream collector. Put onEach before catch if its failure belongs to that recovery policy; after catch if it must remain downstream.
  • onCompletion { cause -> } observes normal completion, failure or cancellation. It does not suppress failure; emitting fallback is safe only on normal completion. Use it for metrics/cleanup, not as catch.
  • retry/retryWhen re-subscribes to upstream. That repeats upstream builders, network calls and side effects. Predicate by typed transient failures and attempt; never retry programmer defects, cancellation, authentication/authorization, validation or deterministic 4xx errors.
  • Backoff belongs inside retryWhen: bounded attempts, exponential delay capped to a maximum, jitter to avoid synchronized clients, network/connectivity policy, and total deadline. Inject randomness/clock for tests. Server Retry-After may override client delay within product bounds.
  • Always preserve CancellationException: rethrow it (and do not wrap it into domain error). Materialize expected domain errors as Result/sealed value when the stream should continue; let invariant/programmer failures terminate and surface.

stateIn/shareIn lifecycle, cache та single source of truth#

  • stateIn/shareIn launch sharing in the supplied scope; that scope owns upstream lifetime. ViewModel scope is screen lifetime, application/repository scope may outlive screens, and an unowned/global scope hides leaks and retry lifetime.
  • Eagerly starts now; Lazily starts on first subscriber and keeps running; WhileSubscribed(stopTimeoutMillis, replayExpirationMillis) may stop, expire replay/initial state, then restart. Rotation/subscriber gaps can therefore repeat connection setup, logging or writes.
  • Handle catch/retryWhen/onCompletion before the sharing boundary. Normal upstream completion does not complete hot subscribers; upstream exception is handled by owner scope. Restart semantics depend on strategy and new subscription.
  • Replay hot sharing — не durable cache. It disappears with process/scope and can be reset. Repository/database/network cache policy and invalidation belong to a single source of truth; hot replay avoids duplicate active collection but does not define freshness or persistence.
  • No exactly-once network/database effect follows from sharing. Make effects idempotent, move durable work to a transactional/outbox boundary, and observe by operation ID.

Context, fusion, buffers, concurrency та partial results#

  • flowOn changes context only upstream and may introduce a channel across dispatchers. It cannot change collector context; context preservation still applies.
  • Adjacent channelFlow/callbackFlow, flowOn, buffer and produceIn can fuse into one channel. Capacity/overflow and placement alter suspension, cancellation windows and element loss; do not infer one queue per operator.
  • buffer overlaps producer/consumer; conflate drops intermediates; latest cancels work. Place expensive map before/after a buffer intentionally and measure memory/latency.
  • flatMapMerge concurrency bounds active inner collections, but each inner may open more work. Add backend quotas and structured resource limits; output order is not input order.
  • For independent partial results with failure isolation, use supervisorScope outside Flow to produce typed results, then emit/materialize them. Do not expect merge itself to be a supervisor boundary.

callbackFlow та Android lifecycle re-subscription#

  • callbackFlow is cold: register callback per collector, use thread-safe trySend, inspect failure, and always unregister in awaitClose. Define buffer/overflow when callback rate exceeds consumption.
  • Guard double callback/close and callback races according to source API. Cancellation invokes cleanup; it does not retract callback side effects already performed.
  • repeatOnLifecycle cancels and relaunches collection as lifecycle crosses the target state. A cold callback source re-registers; WhileSubscribed sharing may stop/restart after timeout. Test start/stop counts and make registration idempotent.
  • Share at a longer owner only if concurrent collectors truly should reuse one registration; otherwise sharing can retain sensors/listeners longer than UI need.

Guarantees vs non-guarantees#

GuaranteeNon-guarantee
combine uses latest values after every input emitted once; zip pairs; merge interleaves concurrent inputs.Universal ordering, atomic multi-source snapshots, or emission when one combine input never emits.
Latest operators request cancellation of previous work.Preemption of blocking/non-cooperative code or rollback of external side effects.
retryWhen can conditionally re-subscribe.Safe/idempotent repeats, recovery from auth/validation/programmer errors, or exactly-once effects.
catch sees upstream non-cancellation failures.It catches downstream collector failures or cancellation.
Sharing reuses an upstream within scope/start policy and can replay memory values.Replay is durable cache, lifecycle restart is invisible, or a network/database effect happens exactly once.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • flatMapLatest, flatMapMerge, transformLatest, mapLatest, dynamic debounce and some sharing APIs may carry experimental/preview annotations in particular resolved releases. Inspect the pinned kotlinx-coroutines API, not memory.
  • Default merge concurrency is library/property-sensitive; pass an explicit value when it is an operational contract. Default buffer capacities are implementation/configuration details.
  • SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed overloads, Duration support and replay expiration annotations vary by release. Pin one coroutines family and test exact boundaries.
  • AndroidX lifecycle APIs and collectAsStateWithLifecycle signatures/default states depend on resolved AndroidX versions; lifecycle semantics do not create delivery durability.

Decision framework#

  1. State the requirement: paired, latest snapshot, all concurrent results, latest-wins, ordered all-results, or durable work.
  2. Mark initial-value, normal completion and failure behavior for every source.
  3. Choose cancellation and concurrency; classify every external side effect as idempotent, transactional, compensatable or unsafe to repeat.
  4. Place context, buffers, catch/retry and hot boundary; assign owner scope/start/expiration.
  5. Define source of truth, freshness/invalidation, lifecycle re-subscription, observability fields and deterministic test timeline.

Trade-offs і failure modes#

  • combine gives responsive latest state but can recompute frequently and wait forever for an unseeded input; zip preserves pairing but stalls behind imbalance; merge maximizes concurrency but gives nondeterministic interleaving.
  • Latest-wins reduces stale UI and wasted cooperative work but drops partial progress; concat preserves all/order with latency; merge improves throughput with ordering, load and memory costs.
  • Broad catch { emit(emptyList()) } hides incidents and converts programmer bugs to plausible empty UI. Broad infinite retry amplifies outages and battery/network use.
  • Sharing prevents duplicate active subscriptions but wrong scope leaks work; short stop timeout thrashes, long timeout retains resources; replay can expose stale memory state.
  • Lifecycle re-collection plus retry plus sharing restart can multiply side effects. Observe starts, attempts, cancellations and operation IDs rather than only final UI.

Production scenario: offline-first search screen#

Гіпотетично: normalized query, account і filters combine into a versioned request. Query uses debounce/distinct/latest. Repository returns database Flow as single source of truth; refresh writes network results transactionally into DB under request key. UI observes DB plus typed refresh status. A request generation prevents stale uncancellable completion from updating the current request. Transient IO gets bounded jittered retry; auth/validation becomes explicit domain state and cancellation is rethrown.

data class RequestKey(val query: String, val filters: Filters, val accountId: String)

val uiState = combine(query, filters, account) { q, f, a ->
    RequestKey(q.trim(), f, a.id)
}.debounce(300).distinctUntilChanged().flatMapLatest { key ->
    repository.observeRows(key)
        .map<_, SearchUiState> { rows -> SearchUiState.Content(key, rows) } // widen type so catch can emit Error
        .onStart { repository.refresh(key) } // idempotent/transactional boundary required
        .retryWhen { e, attempt ->
            val retry = e is IOException && attempt < 3
            if (retry) delay(backoffWithJitter(attempt))
            retry
        }
        .catch { e ->
            if (e is CancellationException) throw e
            emit(SearchUiState.Error(key, e.toDomainError()))
        }
}.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), SearchUiState.Initial)

onStart placement means refresh belongs to each inner subscription and may repeat after retry/restart; production code may move refresh behind repository deduplication/transaction. There is no exactly-once network/database effect: stable keys, idempotency and persisted reconciliation carry that requirement.

Code-review/debugging trap#

query.flatMapMerge { api.search(it) }          // stale results + unbounded intent
    .catch { emit(emptyList()) }               // hides cancellation/domain/programmer failures
    .retryWhen { _, _ -> true }                // infinite re-subscription and repeated effects
    .shareIn(GlobalScope, Eagerly, replay = 1) // leaked owner; replay is not persistence

Review asks: Which result wins? What happens before every source emits? Which operator can repeat an effect? Is cancellation preserved? Who owns sharing? Where is durable truth? Debug with correlation/request ID, query key, attempt, upstream start/stop, subscriber count, cancellation cause, latency, buffer/drop counters and lifecycle state. Never log sensitive query/token payloads.

Deterministic testing та observability#

  • Use one runTest and shared TestCoroutineScheduler for all injected StandardTestDispatchers. Avoid real dispatchers/delays; use runCurrent, advanceTimeBy and advanceUntilIdle around exact boundaries.
  • Composition: script timestamps and assert combine initial barrier/latest snapshots, zip pairs/early completion, merge membership without false global order, and sibling cancellation on failure.
  • Latest/retry: make old inner suspend in finally-observable fake, advance debounce exactly, assert cancellation and no stale reduction; count subscriptions/side effects, predicate errors, backoff+jitter bounds and cancellation during delay.
  • Sharing/lifecycle: collect in backgroundScope, count upstream starts/stops, cross stop timeout and replayExpirationMillis, re-subscribe, cancel owner, and assert replay/reset. Lifecycle integration asserts callback registration/cleanup.
  • Production telemetry should distinguish requested, admitted, started, cancelled, retried, succeeded, materialized error, dropped/stale-rejected and rendered—not infer them from one “success” event.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. combine, zip чи merge? Combine дає latest snapshot після first value кожного input; zip — positional pairs і завершується з shorter side; merge — concurrent interleaving без cross-source order.
  2. Який flatten operator? Concat — всі inner flows послідовно; merge — concurrent all-results з limit; latest — лише newest intent із cooperative cancellation.
  3. Чому search усе ще може показати stale result із flatMapLatest? Blocking/non-cooperative або detached work може завершитися зовні; перевіряйте request key/generation у reducer і не запускайте unstructured children.
  4. Де поставити catch? Після operators, failures яких він має recover-ити, і до sharing/materialization boundary. Downstream collector failures він не ловить.
  5. Що означає onCompletion? Observation normal/failure/cancellation із nullable cause; не suppression. Для fallback on failure потрібен catch.
  6. Коли retry safe? Лише для classified transient failure, bounded attempts/deadline/backoff/jitter і repeat-safe upstream. Не для auth, validation, bugs чи cancellation.
  7. Чому WhileSubscribed дублює I/O? Після stop новий subscriber re-starts cold upstream. Виберіть owner/timeout та idempotent setup, протестуйте start count.
  8. Чи є replay cache? Лише in-memory replay у lifetime hot object; не durable, не freshness policy і не single source of truth.
  9. Як отримати partial results? Materialize per-source domain outcome; якщо потрібна незалежна concurrent isolation, supervisorScope outside Flow продукує typed results.
  10. Як тестувати timing? runTest + один shared scheduler, controlled fakes, explicit virtual-time steps і assertions на cancellation/subscription/attempt counts, не wall-clock sleeps.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Один combine input нормально завершився після value. Його latest value може далі комбінуватися з emissions інших inputs; задокументуйте, чи stale completed dimension допустимий.
  2. Retry metrics показують одну user action, але три POST. Retry re-subscribed upstream. POST потребує idempotency key/status reconciliation або retry boundary лише навколо safe read.
  3. Rotation reconnects callback twice. Trace repeatOnLifecycle, sharing stop timeout і owner scope; make register/unregister symmetric and test concurrent subscribers.
  4. Потрібен input order і concurrency. Assign sequence IDs, bound flatMapMerge, then reorder/materialize at explicit aggregator—or use concat if latency allows. Merge does not preserve it.

5 self-check без відповідей#

  1. Який initial/completion/error contract має кожен source і що буде, якщо він ніколи не emit-ить?
  2. Де cooperative cancellation закінчується і який stale-result guard потрібен?
  3. Які upstream effects retry/re-subscription/sharing restart можуть повторити?
  4. Хто володіє hot scope, replay lifetime, source of truth та invalidation?
  5. Яка virtual-time timeline доводить debounce, cancellation, retry і replay expiration?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do you design a production Kotlin Flow pipeline?

~30-second answer#

I treat a Flow chain as an execution policy. I choose combine for latest snapshots after every input has emitted, zip for pairs, and merge for unordered concurrent values. For search I normalize, debounce, deduplicate, and use flatMapLatest, while still rejecting stale request IDs because cancellation is cooperative. I classify errors before bounded retry, preserve cancellation, and place catch upstream of the boundary it owns. stateIn or shareIn gets an explicit owner scope and start policy; replay is not durable cache. I verify timing, cancellation, retries, sharing restarts, and lifecycle re-subscription with runTest and one shared scheduler.

~2-minute answer#

I start by writing the semantics: do I need positional pairs, a latest multi-source snapshot, all concurrent results, latest-wins, ordered work, or durable work? combine waits for one value from every source and then recomputes with latest values. zip pairs and ends with the shorter side. merge and flatMapMerge interleave concurrent results, so I set an explicit concurrency limit and do not promise ordering. flatMapConcat preserves order, while flatMapLatest, mapLatest, and transformLatest cancel previous cooperative work.

A search chain normally trims, debounces, applies distinctUntilChanged, and flatMaps latest. Because cancellation cannot roll back an HTTP request, database commit, blocking call, or detached coroutine, I also carry a request key and reject stale completion at the reducer. For multi-source state I model initial/loading/error values; otherwise combine can wait forever, and independent sources do not form an atomic snapshot.

I place catch according to exception transparency: it handles upstream non-cancellation failures, not downstream collectors. onCompletion observes termination but does not recover it. retryWhen re-subscribes and may repeat side effects, so I retry only classified transient failures with bounded exponential backoff, jitter and a total deadline; cancellation, programmer, auth and validation errors are not retried. Expected domain errors may become values; invariant failures terminate.

Hot conversion is a lifecycle decision. stateIn/shareIn belongs to a named scope; Eagerly, Lazily and WhileSubscribed have different start, stop, replay expiration and restart behavior. Replay is memory, not durable cache or source of truth. Buffers, flowOn and callbackFlow boundaries affect concurrency and can fuse, so placement is explicit. Android repeatOnLifecycle re-subscribes, and callbackFlow must unregister in awaitClose. Tests use runTest, one TestCoroutineScheduler, controlled sources and exact virtual-time assertions for first emissions, cancellation, retries, upstream start/stop and replay expiration. Telemetry carries request IDs, attempts, cancellation causes and start/stop counts. None of this guarantees exactly-once network or database effects; idempotency and transactional reconciliation do.

Офіційні джерела#

  • Kotlin Flow guide та kotlinx.coroutines Flow API
  • combine, zip, merge
  • flatMapLatest, flatMapMerge, flatMapConcat, transformLatest, mapLatest
  • catch, onCompletion, retryWhen
  • stateIn, shareIn, SharingStarted
  • buffer та operator fusion, flowOn, callbackFlow
  • StateFlow and SharedFlow on Android, Lifecycle-aware Flow collection, Testing Kotlin flows on Android
  • kotlinx-coroutines-test, runTest, TestCoroutineScheduler
Android UI architecture та state modeling: MVVM, MVI, UDFрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після етапу ви маєте проєктувати UI architecture через ownership, source of truth, data flow і failure semantics, а не через ярлик MVVM/MVI: розкласти state за lifetime і durability, визначити ViewModel/state-holder boundary, змоделювати loading/content/empty/error/stale/refresh/pagination без прихованих комбінацій, відокремити events/effects від durable outcomes, захистити async transitions від stale results і перевірити reducers, lifecycle та integration boundaries. Stage 10 уже пояснив primitives hot streams; Stage 13 розглядатиме layering/modularization, тому тут фокус лише на UI boundary.

Senior mental model#

Архітектура UI — це карта власності та причинності. Для кожного значення назвіть authoritative owner, lifetime, restore/persistence policy, writers, readers і допустимі transitions. Для кожної дії — хто приймає intent, де виконується business logic, як результат стає state та що відбудеться при повторі, cancellation або process death.

  • MVVM описує ролі View/ViewModel/model; MVI/reducer підкреслює intents і централізовані transitions; UDF задає напрям event → business logic → state → UI. Назви можуть поєднуватися й самі не гарантують separation або testability.
  • UI рендерить snapshot і надсилає semantic events. Screen state holder координує app data та business rules. Local UI state holder володіє лише UI mechanics. Repository лишається межею даних; use case виправданий повторним або складним правилом, не церемонією.
  • Питайте не «MVVM чи MVI?», а «які інваріанти, конкуренція, effect delivery, restore і observability потрібні цьому screen?»

State taxonomy, internals та data flow#

КатегоріяПрикладТиповий owner / lifetime
Domain/app dataOrder, catalog, payment statusRepository/database/server source of truth; живе незалежно від конкретного UI.
Screen UI stateRows prepared for display, access rules, load/refresh/paging statusScreen-level state holder, часто ViewModel; derived із authoritative data та input.
Ephemeral widget stateFocus, drawer, animation, uncommitted text, scroll mechanicsComposable/View/Fragment або plain UI state holder; hoist лише до lowest common owner.
Restorable stateSelected tab, query, item IDrememberSaveable, saved instance state або SavedStateHandle для малого rebuild input.
Durable business stateSubmitted order, completed payment, queued uploadDatabase/server/transactional work; не ViewModel, bundle або in-memory Flow.
UI event → screen state holder → business/data boundary → authoritative outcome
   ↑                                                       │
   └──────────── render(immutable UI state) ← derive/map ───┘

Side effect request → lifecycle-aware UI handler
Durable outcome     → source of truth → UI state (safe after recreation)

Source of truth — це authority для конкретного факту, а не обов’язково один object для всього screen. Database може бути truth для order status, SavedStateHandle — для query input, а local holder — для focus. Derived state має обчислюватися з owners, а не записуватися назад як паралельна копія без synchronization policy.

State shape: sealed phases, orthogonal fields та atomic updates#

  • Sealed phases сильні для взаємовиключних станів: InitialLoading | Content | BlockingError. Orthogonal fields кращі, коли content може співіснувати з isRefreshing, stale marker, non-blocking error або pagination footer.
  • Не кодуйте isLoading + data? + error? без invariants: це створює impossible або неоднозначні combinations. Але й один giant sealed tree може спричинити combinatorial explosion і сховати незалежні owners.
  • Empty — успішно завантажений нульовий результат, не initial loading. Stale content лишається renderable з freshness/retry metadata. Initial failure блокує screen; refresh failure з cache зазвичай non-blocking. Pagination окремо моделює initial load, append in flight, end reached і append error.
  • Публікуйте immutable snapshots і робіть pure atomic transforms через MutableStateFlow.update. val/copy не захищають nested mutable list, map або element; snapshot/copy ownership на boundary.
sealed interface Body {
    data object InitialLoading : Body
    data class Content(val rows: List<RowUi>, val isEmpty: Boolean) : Body
    data class BlockingError(val error: UiError) : Body
}
data class FeedUiState(
    val body: Body = Body.InitialLoading,
    val isRefreshing: Boolean = false,
    val freshness: Freshness = Freshness.Unknown,
    val append: AppendState = AppendState.Idle,
    val notice: Notice? = null,
    val requestId: Long = 0,
)

private val _state = MutableStateFlow(FeedUiState())
fun reduce(result: Result, id: Long) = _state.update { old ->
    if (id != old.requestId) old else old.reduce(result)
}

State holder vs ViewModel; Compose та XML parity#

  • Keep simple element state local; hoist to the lowest common reader/writer. Extract a plain state holder for cohesive UI logic involving focus, scroll, sheet or selection. Use a ViewModel/screen holder when app data, business rules, repositories or survival across configuration change are involved.
  • A ViewModel should not retain Activity, Fragment, View, NavController, Composer, focus/scroll runtime objects or callbacks. Create it through the owner/factory/DI path and scope it deliberately to destination, graph, Activity or other ViewModelStoreOwner; scope determines sharing and lifetime.
  • Compose: stateful route collects with collectAsStateWithLifecycle() and passes plain state/callbacks to stateless content. remember survives recomposition only; rememberSaveable restores saveable UI input across recreation but is not durable storage. Do not move frame-clock UI operations into viewModelScope.
  • XML/Fragment has the same architecture: observe inside viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.repeatOnLifecycle, render Views, send semantic callbacks, and never outlive the Fragment view. Compose is not required for UDF.

UDF loop, events, effects, commands та durable outcomes#

  • Events describe what happened (RetryClicked, AddressChanged), not setters for every field. Handler validates/adopts intent, invokes business/data work, then reduces typed results into state.
  • An effect/command asks an imperative boundary to act: open a picker, focus a field, show a transient snackbar, navigate. Specify loss, replay, buffering, idempotency and consumer count. StateFlow is not an event queue; equal values conflate and new collectors see current state, not every occurrence.
  • Navigation after validation may be a UI effect; the authoritative fact «checkout complete» must be durable outcome in repository/server, so recreation derives the correct destination. Snackbar text can be best-effort; a required user acknowledgement belongs in state. Payment completion must never exist only as consumed event.
  • “Exactly once” is usually a business protocol: stable operation/idempotency key, persisted status and reconciliation. A Channel/SharedFlow alone cannot make an external payment or navigation history exactly once.

Concurrency, stale results та race prevention#

  • UDF does not inherently serialize async effects. Two events can launch overlapping work and complete out of order. Decide latest-wins, queue-all, deduplicate, mutex, single actor, or independent-key concurrency per operation.
  • Cancel obsolete cooperative jobs, but also carry request identity/generation and reject stale completion because cancellation cannot undo blocking calls, detached work or committed external effects.
  • Atomic update prevents lost read-modify-write state updates; it does not make network+database+state a transaction. Keep reducer pure because its lambda may retry.
  • Disable repeated submit only as UX; correctness still needs repository/server idempotency and persisted operation status.

Guarantees vs non-guarantees#

Guarantee / useful contractNon-guarantee
UDF makes direction and write boundaries explicit.UDF does not inherently serialize async effects or prevent races.
Immutable outer snapshots support predictable comparison and reducers.Immutable data does not make nested mutable members safe.
ViewModel is retained across configuration changes by its owner.ViewModel survives process death, or is a durable store.
SavedStateHandle retains small restorable values via saved-state mechanisms.It is a durable database/business-storage or large-object cache.
StateFlow exposes current conflated state.StateFlow is an event queue or delivers every occurrence.
A cohesive aggregate can make atomic screen transitions easier.One UI state object is always superior to smaller owned state holders.
MVVM/MVI names provide shared vocabulary.Architecture pattern names guarantee separation, correctness, or testability.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • collectAsStateWithLifecycle(), lifecycle-runtime-compose artifacts, overloads and default lifecycle behavior depend on resolved AndroidX versions. Pin versions and consult current API docs.
  • Compose saveability and supported types depend on SaveableStateRegistry, navigation integration and platform Bundle limits; test real recreation/process restoration rather than assuming every rememberSaveable value restores.
  • ViewModel creation extras, factories, Navigation graph scoping and SavedStateHandle integration have evolved across Lifecycle/Navigation releases. Verify the actual owner and dependency versions.
  • Do not base semantics on library defaults for Flow sharing/buffering; Stage 10 covers those version-sensitive primitives. Architecture must state required behavior independently.

Decision matrix#

DecisionPreferWhen / cost
Local vs hoistedLowest owner that needs read/writeLocal minimizes coupling; hoist for coordination/testable contract.
Plain holder vs ViewModelPlain for UI mechanics; ViewModel for screen/business dataFramework-free holder is light; ViewModel adds owner/lifecycle and saved-state integration.
MVVM-style methods vs reducer/MVIFew independent actions vs many coupled transitionsReducer centralizes auditability but adds event/boilerplate and can become a god reducer.
Sealed phase vs fieldsSealed for exclusivity; validated fields for orthogonal dimensionsChoose invariants over fashion; hybrid often models refresh/paging best.
Effect vs stateEffect for disposable imperative request; state/durable source for required outcomeIf loss after stop/recreation is a bug, do not model only as transient effect.
One aggregate vs smaller holdersAggregate for atomic invariants; split by independent owner/lifecycleAvoid both inconsistent duplicated facts and monolithic unrelated state.
  1. Write user-visible invariants and classify each fact by owner, lifetime and durability.
  2. Choose source of truth and derive UI state; identify every writer and transition.
  3. Choose exclusive phases vs orthogonal metadata; define stale, empty, refresh and append behavior.
  4. Define event admission, async ordering/cancellation, request identity, effect delivery and process-death recovery.
  5. Choose the least ceremonial pattern that makes these contracts observable and testable.

Trade-offs та failure modes#

  • Dogmatic MVI can route text edits, animation and navigation through one global reducer, increasing latency/boilerplate and coupling unrelated lifetimes. Casual MVVM can scatter writes across callbacks and expose mutable state.
  • Giant UiState causes broad updates and hidden ownership; too many independent flows produce torn combinations and hard-to-test invariants. Split by ownership, aggregate where transitions must be atomic.
  • Replacing cached content with full-screen loading during refresh causes flicker and loses context; treating initial empty as content before load hides latency/failure.
  • Transient navigation/payment success event can be lost on inactive UI or repeated after recreation. Durable outcome plus idempotent UI reaction is safer.
  • Persisting full response objects in SavedStateHandle risks size/schema issues and duplicate truth. Save identifiers/user input; reload authoritative data.
  • Launching per-click jobs without operation policy permits stale overwrite, duplicate payments and spinners cleared by the wrong request.

Production scenario: checkout and payment#

Гіпотетично: checkout screen має local focus/sheet state, SavedStateHandle для cart ID і uncommitted promo input, ViewModel для screen state, repository/database як source of truth для cart і payment operation. Submit створює stable idempotency key, state переходить у submitting, repository persist-ить operation і викликає backend. UI не вважає transient effect доказом оплати: вона observe-ить durable Pending | Succeeded | Failed. При process death новий ViewModel відновлює IDs, читає operation і показує receipt або retry-safe failure.

fun submit() {
    val snapshot = state.value
    if (!snapshot.canSubmit) return
    val operationId = snapshot.operationId ?: ids.newStableId()
    _state.update { it.copy(isSubmitting = true, operationId = operationId) }
    submitJob?.cancel()
    submitJob = viewModelScope.launch {
        repository.submitPayment(snapshot.cartId, operationId)
        // Repository persists outcome; screen observes that source of truth.
    }
}

Double tap і retry reuse operation ID. A stale validation response carries request ID and cannot overwrite newer address. Navigation to receipt is derived from succeeded operation; a best-effort snackbar may remain an effect. Telemetry records redacted screen/operation ID, prior→next state name, event, request generation, latency, cancellation and stale rejection—not card data.

Code-review/debugging trap#

data class UiState(
    val loading: Boolean,
    val items: MutableList<Item>,
    val error: String?,
    val navigateAfterPayment: Boolean,
)
fun refresh() = viewModelScope.launch {
    _state.value = _state.value.copy(loading = true)
    val rows = repo.load()                 // old request may finish last
    _state.value.items.clear()             // mutates a published snapshot
    _state.value.items.addAll(rows)
    _state.value = _state.value.copy(loading = false)
}

Review trap: код має ViewModel, UiState і “MVI” naming, але не має safe ownership. Запитайте: які combinations legal; хто writer; чи refresh зберігає content; який request може завершити spinner; чи nested list mutable; що станеться після rotation/process death; чи payment outcome durable? Для debugging логують typed previousState → event/result → nextState з correlation/request ID, owner/lifecycle, active operation count і stale rejection. Redact payloads; reducer transition logs доповнюють, а не замінюють repository traces.

Testing reducers, holders та integration boundaries#

  • Pure reducer table/property tests cover every event/result × phase, invariants, empty/stale/refresh/append behavior and stale request rejection. Assert whole state and forbidden combinations.
  • ViewModel tests inject fake repositories, IDs and dispatchers; use virtual time to script out-of-order completion, cancellation, duplicate submit and operation recovery. Do not test private Flow implementation details instead of public transitions.
  • Plain state-driven Compose/View tests render loading/content/empty/blocking/non-blocking error and callbacks. Add a small wiring test for lifecycle collection and effect handling.
  • Integration tests prove repository source-of-truth writes, SavedStateHandle reconstruction, destination/graph scoping, Fragment view recreation and process-recreation-critical paths.
  • Observability uses stable state/event names, correlation and request generation, transition latency, effect enqueue/handle/drop reason, retries and rejected stale results; avoid logging PII/secrets or high-cardinality payloads.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. MVVM, MVI чи UDF? Це не взаємовиключні бренди: оберіть explicit owners/data flow; reducer корисний для coupled transitions, прості ViewModel methods — для незалежних actions.
  2. Що є UI state? Snapshot даних, підготовлених для render, включно з phase/metadata; domain data і widget mechanics можуть мати інших owners.
  3. Один UiState завжди краще? Ні; aggregate дає atomic invariants, але незалежні lifetimes/owners краще розділити.
  4. Sealed state чи data class? Sealed для mutually exclusive phases; fields для orthogonal dimensions; hybrid уникає boolean soup і combinatorial tree.
  5. Як моделювати refresh failure із cache? Залишити content, завершити refreshing, позначити freshness/non-blocking error і дати retry; blocking error — коли renderable content немає.
  6. State чи event для navigation? Imperative navigation може бути effect, але required/durable business outcome має бути state/source of truth, щоб recreation не губила факт.
  7. Чи переживає ViewModel process death? Ні; config change — так у межах owner. Після process death відновіть мінімальні inputs і reload durable truth.
  8. Для чого SavedStateHandle? Для малого restorable screen input/keys; не база даних і не сховище payment/order truth.
  9. Як не допустити stale result? Cancel obsolete cooperative job і перевірити request ID/generation перед reducer; для writes додати idempotency та reconciliation.
  10. Як тестувати architecture? Pure transition tests, ViewModel concurrency tests, plain UI render/callback tests і кілька lifecycle/persistence integration tests.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Collector був STOPPED під час snackbar. Визначте contract: best-effort message можна втратити; required acknowledgement є state. Не маскуйте невизначеність словом “single event”.
  2. Два refresh завершилися навпаки. latest request owns refresh flag/data; compare generation. Cancellation alone insufficient; repository truth may independently update.
  3. Screen має editor, list і bottom sheet. Split local editor/sheet mechanics і screen data holder; aggregate тільки facts, що потребують atomic invariant.
  4. Payment succeeded, app died before navigation. Persist operation outcome server/DB, restore operation ID, observe success and derive receipt route idempotently.

4 self-check без відповідей#

  1. Хто authoritative owner, writer, lifetime і restore policy кожного state field?
  2. Які impossible/hidden combinations допускає поточна model для loading, stale, refresh і pagination?
  3. Яка async operation policy і як reducer відхиляє stale completion?
  4. Які “events” насправді є durable business outcomes, втрата яких неприпустима?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do you design Android UI architecture and state?

~30-second answer#

I treat MVVM and MVI as vocabulary, not guarantees. I first assign each fact an owner, lifetime, source of truth, and durability. The UI sends semantic events and renders immutable state; a screen holder coordinates business data, while widget mechanics stay in the lowest UI owner. I model exclusive phases with sealed types and orthogonal refresh or paging metadata separately. UDF does not serialize asynchronous work, so I define cancellation and request identity. Required outcomes such as payment completion are persisted, not sent only as one-off events, and I test reducers, races, recreation, and repository boundaries.

~2-minute answer#

I start with ownership and data flow rather than choosing a pattern name. Domain data belongs to a repository or durable source of truth. A screen state holder, often a ViewModel, combines that data with screen input and exposes renderable UI state. Focus, scroll, animation, and similar mechanics stay local or in a plain UI state holder unless business logic needs them. In Compose I collect lifecycle-aware state in a route and pass values and callbacks to stateless content; the same boundary works with Fragments and repeatOnLifecycle.

For state shape, I use sealed phases where states are mutually exclusive, such as initial loading, content, and blocking error. Refresh, stale status, non-blocking errors, and pagination are often orthogonal to content, so a hybrid model avoids both boolean soup and an enormous sealed hierarchy. Published snapshots are immutable, nested collections have controlled ownership, and atomic updates are pure.

Events describe user intent. The holder runs business logic and reduces typed results back into state. Imperative requests such as focus or a disposable snackbar can be effects, but StateFlow is not an event queue. If losing an outcome after recreation would be wrong—payment completion, order submission, required acknowledgement—I persist it and derive UI behavior from durable state. A ViewModel survives configuration change, not process death, and SavedStateHandle stores minimal reconstruction inputs, not business truth.

Finally, UDF alone does not serialize concurrent work. I define latest-wins, queueing, deduplication, or independent-key concurrency, cancel obsolete jobs, and reject stale request IDs. Writes use idempotency and reconciliation. Tests cover pure reducer transitions, out-of-order results, duplicate submit, lifecycle collection, saved-state reconstruction, and source-of-truth integration. That gives me explicit contracts; calling it MVVM or MVI is secondary.
