Clean Architecture та Android modularizationрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після етапу ви маєте проєктувати межі за напрямом змін, ownership і залежностями, а не за назвами папок: застосувати dependency rule, відділити policy від mechanism, вирішити, чи потрібен domain layer/use case/repository interface, обрати model boundaries і ціну mapping, перейти від logical packages до Gradle modules лише з вимірюваною користю, та мігрувати моноліт поступово з автоматичними dependency fitness rules. Це не повтор Stage 12 про UI state і не детальний Stage 17 про DI framework.

Senior mental model#

Architecture is controlled coupling. Clean Architecture — це dependency rule, а не кільця, назви domain/data/presentation чи фіксована кількість шарів. Високорівнева policy не повинна знати нестабільний mechanism; source-code dependencies спрямовують до стабільної policy, а runtime control flow може йти назовні через implementation, підставлену composition root.

  • Policy — бізнес-рішення та інваріанти: eligibility, pricing, retry classification. Mechanism — Android, HTTP, SQL, analytics, clock. Мінливість і ownership важливіші за назву package.
  • Boundary цінна, якщо вона локалізує change, дає незалежний contract/test або ownership. Interface, mapper чи module без такої причини — ceremony.
  • Оцінюйте систему двома графами: compile-time dependencies і runtime calls/data flow. Dependency inversion змінює перший, не заперечуючи другий.

Dependency graph та internals#

compile time:
:app ──> :feature:checkout ──> :feature:checkout:api (owns port/policy)
  │                                             ▲
  ├──> :data:orders ────────────────────────────┘ (implements port)
  └──> :core:navigation-api

runtime:
UI → CheckoutPolicy → OrderRepository(port) → Sql/HttpOrderRepository(adapter)

Forbidden: :core:domain → Android/Retrofit/Room/feature implementation
Risk: feature A ↔ feature B cycle; shared module with unbounded fan-out

Gradle створює directed project graph і task graph. Цикл project dependencies не є «двосторонньою співпрацею», а ознакою неправильного ownership; винесіть малий contract, переорієнтуйте orchestration або об’єднайте те, що змінюється разом. Високий fan-out означає багато причин зміни для consumer; високий fan-in робить boundary стабільною й дорогою для breaking changes. Stable dependency principle: нестабільні features залежать від стабільних contracts, але «stable» не означає «ніколи не змінюється».

Presentation/domain/data та моделі#

  • Presentation адаптує interaction/result до UI contract; data координує sources, cache, conflict/freshness і persistence; optional domain концентрує reusable/complex policy. Немає обов’язкової кількості шарів: простий CRUD screen може напряму викликати data boundary, а складна pricing policy виграє від pure domain.
  • Domain layer допомагає, коли правило повторно використовується кількома callers, комбінує repositories, має нетривіальні invariants або потребує platform-free тестів. Він шкодить, коли кожен клас лише делегує один method, дублює names/types і розтягує tracing.
  • DTO відображає wire schema і tolerates transport concerns; database entity — storage schema/index/relations; domain model виражає validated business meaning; UI model — formatted/permission-aware display contract. Не називайте Room entity «domain entity» лише через Clean Architecture vocabulary.
  • Mapping ізолює schema evolution і invalid data, але коштує allocations, boilerplate, defaults, lost fields та debugging hops. Мапте на trust/change boundaries; не створюйте чотири ідентичні моделі автоматично. Для простого stable internal value спільна модель може бути чеснішою.

Repository ownership, inversion та use cases#

Repository не є автоматично domain abstraction. Якщо API — CRUD façade над endpoint і витікає paging/HTTP DTO, це data gateway незалежно від назви. Repository interface належить policy-side consumer, коли policy визначає потрібні capability й має кілька implementations/test substitutes; adapter module реалізує цей port. Якщо contract суто data-centric і використовується багатьма features, ownership у data API може бути кращим. Уникайте одного god repository.

Interfaces alone do not decouple. Consumer лишається coupled до semantics, models, errors, threading, versioning і lifetime. Interface корисний, коли відділяє volatile implementation або формує consumer-owned narrow port; one-to-one interface для кожного concrete class лише додає navigation cost.

Use case виправданий, коли називає business operation, оркеструє кілька ports, enforce-ить policy/transaction boundary або повторно використовується. GetUserUseCase(repo).invoke() = repo.getUser() без окремої semantics — pass-through layer. Простий call можна лишити на repository; додайте use case, коли виникне policy seam.

Package-by-feature/layer; logical та Gradle modules#

  • package-by-layer (ui/, domain/, data/) показує technical role, але feature change розкиданий і accidental cross-feature access легкий. Package-by-feature colocalizes change та ownership; усередині великої feature можна мати локальні layers. Packages — logical organization/visibility, не окрема compilation unit.
  • Gradle module дає enforced dependency edge, окрему compilation/cache/task/API surface і ownership boundary, але додає configuration, variants, plugins, resources, dependency wiring та IDE/build overhead. Спочатку доведіть seam logical packages/internal visibility; фізично виділяйте за change cadence, reuse, build graph або командною межею.
  • Типовий graph: thin :app як composition/manifest entry; vertical :feature:*; вузькі :core:*; конкретні :data:*; :design-system для owned tokens/components/resources; :testing або test fixtures для reusable test tools. Не робіть :core:common звалищем.

Module types, api/implementation та delivery#

  • implementation приховує dependency від compile classpath consumers і зменшує accidental API/fan-out; api потрібен, коли public signature модуля справді expose-ить type dependency. Це Gradle classpath contract, не security boundary.
  • Kotlin/JVM module підходить pure policy/models без Android resources/classes і часто має простіший variant/task surface. Android library потрібна для resources, manifest, Android APIs, BuildConfig або Android tests; AAR/resource namespace і variants мають ціну.
  • dynamic feature — Play Feature Delivery/deployment concern з install-time/on-demand/conditional behavior, base-module relationship, install failure та unavailable-code/resource states. Не використовуйте її як синонім звичайного feature library і не припускайте, що compile module фізично завантажується окремо.

Navigation, DI contracts, resources та stable boundaries#

  • Feature не повинна import implementation іншої feature. Expose малий navigation contract: typed destination/entry interface або registrar; app-level composition connects graph. Не передавайте internal screen classes чи NavController через core. Деталі navigation — Stage 4.
  • DI contract складається з required ports та exported entry point; composition root обирає implementation. Не створюйте bidirectional «DI module» dependency і не ховайте service locator у core. Scope/binding internals належать Stage 17.
  • Resource ownership: feature володіє своїми strings/drawables; design system — shared tokens/assets із versioned naming. Не покладайтеся на випадкові transitive R references; namespace/non-transitive R behavior залежить від AGP.
  • Convention plugin централізує повторювану build policy — toolchains, lint, test defaults, Android options — без copy/paste. Це executable build governance, але plugin має бути малим, versioned/tested і не застосовувати всі plugins/dependencies усюди.

Build performance, teams, blast radius та testability#

Модулі можуть дозволити parallelism, caching та recompilation лише affected projects, але граф, ABI changes, annotation/code generation, configuration cost і critical path визначають результат. Більше modules не завжди швидше: serial chain із tiny modules може погіршити configuration і task overhead. Міряйте clean build, incremental ABI/non-ABI edit, configuration time, cache hit rate і critical path на CI/репрезентативних machines.

Організаційно boundary може дати CODEOWNERS, локальні tests, менший blast radius і незалежну evolution. Але shared core із десятками consumers збільшує coordination; test doubles, які повторюють implementation, дають фальшиву впевненість. Test pure policy locally, adapter contract/integration на boundary, feature flow із fakes та кілька app composition tests.

Guarantees та explicit non-guarantees#

Корисний contractНе гарантує
Dependency rule забороняє policy compile against конкретний mechanism.Назви domain/data або mandated layer count; There is no mandated layer count.
Consumer-owned port дозволяє підставити adapter.A repository is not automatically a domain abstraction; Interfaces alone do not decouple.
Gradle module enforce-ить declared compile dependency graph.Modules do not guarantee runtime isolation or security; код часто потрапляє в один process/APK.
implementation звужує compile exposure.Runtime encapsulation, semantic independence або відсутність transitive runtime code.
Measured seams можуть зменшити change/test blast radius.Modularization does not guarantee quality or build speed.

Version/build-sensitive behavior#

  • AGP/Gradle/Kotlin compatibility, variant APIs, namespace, non-transitive/non-final R, test fixtures, configuration cache і Kotlin compiler behavior змінюються. Pin toolchains, читайте release notes й перевіряйте resolved graph.
  • api/implementation semantics залежать від applied library plugins і public signatures; перевіряйте dependency reports/ABI, а не назву configuration у вакуумі.
  • Dynamic delivery залежить від Android App Bundle, Play/installer, device/API, delivery conditions і версії Play Feature Delivery library; тестуйте install/uninstall/failure paths.
  • Build-performance твердження валідні лише для конкретного graph, hardware, cache, daemon, CI та edit scenario. Зберігайте baseline до/після migration.

Decision framework#

  1. Намалюйте current package/project dependency graph, owners, cycles, fan-in/fan-out і hotspots change.
  2. Для candidate boundary назвіть policy, volatile mechanism, contract owner, allowed direction і дані/errors, що перетинають seam.
  3. Оцініть benefit: independent change/team/reuse/test/build/delivery; і cost: mapping, API versioning, variants, resources, navigation/DI wiring.
  4. Спробуйте cheapest enforcement: package-by-feature, internal, lint/architecture test. Створюйте Gradle module, якщо потрібен compile/build/ownership boundary.
  5. Зафіксуйте fitness rule та before/after metrics; rollback/merge boundary, якщо cost перевищує benefit.

Trade-offs та failure modes#

  • Layer-first architecture породжує horizontal god modules і довгі зміни; feature-only може дублювати policy або створити direct feature dependencies.
  • Надмірні models/mappers гублять fields і збільшують allocations; shared DTO протікає transport schema в policy та робить backend change blast radius.
  • Pass-through use cases/interfaces ускладнюють tracing; відсутній seam прив’язує policy до Retrofit/Room/Android.
  • :core:common, design-system або navigation module з необмеженим API набуває високий fan-out і стає coordination bottleneck.
  • Надто дрібні Gradle modules збільшують plugin/configuration/variant cost; один app module не enforce-ить ownership і recompiles broad graph.
  • Dependency cycle, reflection/service locator або duplicate model копіювання обходять intended graph; green compilation ще не доводить correct runtime composition.

Production migration: seams та strangler#

Гіпотетично: checkout живе в monolithic :app; UI напряму викликає Retrofit service, Room DAO і pricing singleton. Baseline: checkout files/change coupling, module build critical path, incremental edit time, flaky integration tests, cycle count і owners. Команда спершу вводить package-by-feature та narrow CheckoutPolicy/OrderRepository seam, адаптує legacy implementation і переключає один user journey — strangler, не big-bang rewrite.

Далі pure pricing/order contracts переходять у Kotlin/JVM :feature:checkout:api або domain module лише якщо reuse/ownership це виправдовує; Android UI/resources лишаються в feature Android library, Retrofit/Room adapter — у :data:orders, app — composition root. Старий path видаляють після parity metrics: conversion/error rate, contract tests, compile graph, incremental/CI time. Кожен slice deployable; rollback повертає composition binding, а не весь rewrite.

Code-review/debugging trap#

// :feature:checkout depends on :feature:catalog:impl
class CheckoutUseCase(
    private val repo: CheckoutRepositoryImpl,
) {
    suspend operator fun invoke(id: String) = repo.loadDto(id) // pass-through + DTO leak
}

interface CheckoutRepository // declared beside the implementation, no consumer capability

Trap: diagram має «clean» boxes, але dependency йде до implementation, use case не містить policy, DTO перетинає всі boundaries, а catalog/checkout можуть утворити cycle. Debug спочатку через dependencies/dependencyInsight і project graph, потім знайдіть public signature, що expose-ить edge, owner contract і runtime composition. Fix: narrow consumer-owned port, explicit mapper/error contract, app orchestration або neutral API module — не ще один generic interface.

Dependency fitness rules у CI#

  • Fail CI on project/package cycles, forbidden edges (domain → android.*, feature → feature:impl) і unexpected public API growth; allowlist має owner/expiry.
  • Перевіряйте graph snapshot, dependency locks/verification, lint/architecture tests, Kotlin explicit API/API dumps для published contracts і Android resource-prefix/namespace conventions.
  • Track fan-out/fan-in, changed modules per PR, ABI vs implementation invalidation, configuration/critical-path time, cache hits, flaky tests і cross-team review count. Threshold має сигналізувати regression, не gamify число modules.
  • CI rule повинно пояснювати violation і локальну команду; version convention plugins і contract tests разом із boundary.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. Що є суттю Clean Architecture? Dependency rule: policy не компілюється проти volatile mechanisms; naming і кількість layers вторинні.
  2. Коли потрібен domain layer? Для reused/complex policy, multi-repository orchestration або platform-free invariants; не для автоматичних one-line wrappers.
  3. Де має жити repository interface? У owner потрібного contract: часто consumer/policy для inversion, інколи stable data API для shared data capability.
  4. Чи потрібні DTO, domain і UI model завжди? Ні. Розділяйте різні schemas/trust/change cadence; враховуйте mapping і debugging cost.
  5. Package-by-feature чи layer? Feature зазвичай локалізує change/ownership; локальні layers усередині feature зберігають roles без horizontal god packages.
  6. Package і Gradle module — те саме? Ні. Package організує/обмежує source; Gradle project створює compilation, dependency, task та API boundary з overhead.
  7. api чи implementation? Default implementation; api лише коли dependency type є навмисною частиною public consumer surface.
  8. Android library чи Kotlin/JVM? Kotlin/JVM для pure code; Android library, коли потрібні resources, manifest, Android APIs або Android-specific tests.
  9. Чи більше модулів прискорює build? Не гарантовано. Parallel/cache isolation може допомогти, але configuration, variants і serial critical path можуть погіршити; міряйте scenarios.
  10. Як мігрувати моноліт? Baseline metrics → logical seam → adapter → один strangler slice → enforce graph → extract physical module only when benefit is proven.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Дві features потребують переходу одна в одну. Не додавайте cycle: app-level navigator/orchestrator залежить від їхніх destination contracts або neutral navigation API.
  2. Після extraction build став повільнішим. Порівняйте configuration, task count, critical path, cache і ABI invalidation; скоротіть plugin/variant surface або merge tiny serial modules.
  3. Domain model майже дорівнює DTO. Якщо trust/schema/cadence справді однакові, shared model може бути дешевшою; додайте mapping, коли boundary diverges, не за шаблоном.
  4. Dynamic feature не встановилася. Base має працювати без її code/resources, показати retry/fallback і зберегти route intent; test install cancellation, failure, update та unavailable state.

4 unanswered self-checks#

  1. Які три найбільші change hotspots/cycles/fan-out edges у вашому current graph?
  2. Яка policy зараз знає Android, network або storage mechanism, і який narrow port їй реально потрібен?
  3. Які mappings захищають різні schemas, а які лише дублюють fields без користі?
  4. Які before/after product, ownership, test і build metrics доведуть, що extraction варта cost?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do you apply Clean Architecture and modularization in an Android app?

~30-second answer#

I treat Clean Architecture as a dependency rule, not a mandated folder diagram. Stable business policy owns narrow contracts; Android, database, and network mechanisms implement them at the composition boundary. I add domain models, use cases, and mappers only when they protect real invariants or change boundaries. I start with package-by-feature and extract Gradle modules for measurable ownership, reuse, build, or delivery needs. I prevent cycles and implementation leaks in CI and compare incremental build, test, and change-blast-radius metrics, because more modules do not automatically improve quality or speed.

~2-minute answer#

I begin with policy and volatility. Business rules should not compile against Retrofit, Room, Android, or a feature implementation. A consumer-owned port describes the capability the policy needs, an outer adapter implements it, and the app composition root connects them. Runtime calls can still go outward; dependency inversion is about source dependencies.

I do not mandate presentation, domain, and data for every feature. A domain layer earns its cost when it centralizes reused or complex policy. A use case should name an operation or coordinate rules, not just forward one repository call. DTOs, persistence entities, domain models, and UI models are separate when schemas, trust, or change cadence differ; every mapper also adds allocation, defaults, and debugging cost.

Organizationally, I prefer package-by-feature, then extract Gradle modules when I need an enforced compile boundary, ownership, reuse, cache isolation, or delivery. The app is a thin composition root; features expose narrow APIs; core, data, design-system, and testing modules each have explicit ownership. I default to implementation dependencies, use api only for intentional public types, and keep pure policy in Kotlin/JVM modules. Dynamic features are a delivery mechanism, not ordinary architecture modules.

I reject cycles, feature-to-implementation edges, and unbounded shared modules with CI fitness rules. Navigation and DI cross features through small contracts; resources stay with their owner and convention plugins centralize build policy. For a monolith I establish metrics, introduce a logical seam and legacy adapter, migrate one strangler slice, then extract physically. I verify product parity, fan-out, changed modules, incremental and CI critical-path time. Modules enforce a build graph, not runtime isolation, security, quality, or guaranteed speed.

Jetpack Compose runtime та stateрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після етапу ви маєте пояснити, як Compose будує й оновлює UI через composition і snapshot state; вибрати observable state, owner, lifetime та save boundary; розрізняти invalidation, recomposition, skipping і phase-specific work; безпечно застосувати remember, rememberSaveable, snapshot collections, derivedStateOf, mutation policies і key; та діагностувати stale UI, загублену identity і неправильні очікування від runtime. Stage 12 визначив screen-state architecture; тут фокус на Compose runtime/local state. snapshotFlow лише порівнюється, а effects/navigation належать Stage 15; глибокий performance analysis — Stage 16.

Senior mental model#

Composition — це incremental execution із identity та tracked dependencies, не повторний inflate дерева. Compiler додає runtime protocol; Composer зіставляє call sites/groups із slot table, runtime відстежує snapshot reads, а зміна може invalidate конкретний restart scope або пізнішу phase. Invalidation лише робить роботу eligible: runtime може coalesce, skip або cancel її.

  • Описуйте чотири окремі речі: state write → invalidation → scheduled work → фактично виконані composition/layout/draw.
  • State має одночасно бути observable, належати правильному owner-у й мати правильний lifetime. remember вирішує лише positional retention у composition.
  • Composable — декларативний опис, який може виконатися повторно, у іншому порядку, бути пропущений або скасований; тому він idempotent і side-effect-free.

Runtime, internals та topology#

@Composable source
  → Compose compiler protocol (Composer + change/group metadata)
  → initial composition: execute calls, create groups/slots, emit UI tree
  → snapshot reads associate state with observing scopes/phases
state write → snapshot/apply → invalidate affected observations
  → recomposition may re-execute restart scopes and skip unchanged groups
  → apply changes → layout (measure/place) → draw

identity ≈ call-site/group position + explicit key where supplied
remembered value lives in its slot while that identity remains composed

Slot table — runtime representation of composition groups and remembered slots, not a public DOM чи stable storage format. Group boundaries and restart scopes are introduced by compiler/runtime protocol around eligible composable calls. Positional memoization normally identifies an invocation by call site and relative execution position. Initial composition creates topology and values; recomposition revisits invalidated portions and records changes. Do not promise “every state change reruns the whole function/tree”: restartability, eligibility for skipping, actual parameter comparisons and observation location determine work.

Conditional calls change positions. In loops/reordered siblings, explicit key(item.id) gives stable local identity so remembered objects and lifecycle follow the logical item. Keys must be unique among siblings at that call site and stable for the item; index keys preserve position, not item identity.

Snapshot reads, writes, mutable snapshots і threads#

  • MutableState і snapshot collections participate у Compose snapshot system. Reads are observed in a context; writes create state records and, when applied/committed, notify relevant observers according to mutation policy.
  • A mutable snapshot provides isolated reads/writes until apply. Concurrent snapshots can conflict when incompatible writes target the same state; apply can fail and callers using low-level snapshot APIs need an explicit retry/merge/error policy. Do not describe snapshots as database transactions or global locks.
  • Visibility belongs to snapshot/apply semantics. Arbitrary cross-thread mutation of ordinary fields is neither tracked nor made safe. Use supported snapshot APIs, confine UI state ownership where practical, publish/apply changes correctly, and synchronize non-snapshot mutable data with normal concurrency tools.
  • Atomicity of a snapshot apply does not make external I/O atomic, does not serialize business operations, and does not guarantee every intermediate value is rendered.

Composition, layout і draw phases#

Де readЩо описуєТипова invalidation
CompositionЩо входить у UI, parameters/modifiersRecomposition відповідного scope; потім зміни можуть вимагати layout/draw.
Layout: measure/placeSize та positionRemeasure або placement; measure change може propagate.
DrawPixels/graphicsRedraw без обов’язкової recomposition/layout.

Runtime tracks phase of a snapshot read. Перенесення fast-changing read у placement/draw lambda може звузити work, лише якщо UI structure не залежить від value. Це не універсальна оптимізація: correctness і measurement dependencies важливіші; детальне profiling — Stage 16.

State authoring: observable values та collections#

@Composable
fun Filters(initial: Set<String>) {
    var query by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val selected = remember { mutableStateListOf<String>() }
    // query assignment and selected.add/remove are observable snapshot writes.
}

// Hidden mutation: State's value reference never changes.
val rows = remember { mutableStateOf(mutableListOf<Row>()) }
rows.value.add(newRow) // MutableList mutation is not observed by mutableStateOf.
// Prefer mutableStateListOf<Row>() + add, or hold an immutable List and replace it:
// val rows = remember { mutableStateOf(listOf<Row>()) }; rows.value = rows.value + newRow

remember { mutableStateOf(x) } both retains the state holder while the call identity remains and makes assignments observable. A plain local var resets on execution; a remembered ordinary mutable object survives but does not notify Compose. mutableStateListOf/mutableStateMapOf observe their collection operations, not hidden mutation inside arbitrary element objects. Prefer immutable element replacement or observable fields with explicit ownership.

remember(key1, key2) { build(...) } recreates cached value when a key changes. Missing a dependency produces a stale cache; using a volatile key destroys retention. The calculation should not perform external effects.

remember, rememberSaveable, ViewModel та Saver#

MechanismLifetime / purposeBoundary
rememberRecomposition while identity remains composedDoes not survive leaving composition, Activity recreation, or process death.
rememberSaveableSmall UI element state restorable through SaveableStateRegistryRequires Bundle-compatible value or custom Saver; not durable storage.
ViewModelScreen/business state owner across configuration changesDoes not itself survive process death; use SavedStateHandle for minimal restorable input and durable repository for business truth.

Saver, mapSaver і listSaver convert a state holder to minimal saveable values and reconstruct it. Save query, selected IDs or scroll key/index—not repositories, callbacks, coroutine scopes, large object graphs or duplicate server data. Restoration can occur after system recreation; validate missing/old values and rebuild runtime-only dependencies.

State hoisting та plain state holders#

  • Keep simple element state local when one composable owns it. Hoist value + events to the lowest common owner that must read or change it—not automatically to the screen root.
  • Extract a plain state holder when cohesive UI behavior coordinates several element states. Create it with a remember…State factory; if restoration matters, save minimal reconstructible values with a truthful Saver.
  • Business rules, repositories and durable screen state belong to a screen owner such as ViewModel/component as established in Stage 12. Pass observable immutable values/callbacks into stateless rendering.
  • State holder lifetime must match objects it owns. A composition-owned holder may safely encapsulate Compose UI state; do not leak it into a longer-lived owner.

derivedStateOf та mutation policies#

derivedStateOf tracks snapshot reads and is useful when dependencies change more often than the derived result needed by consumers—for example, scroll index to “show back to top”. It is not a generic memoization wrapper and is not free: it adds observation, calculation and equality bookkeeping. For ordinary computation that should update whenever inputs do, calculate directly or use keyed remember only when avoiding a proven expensive recomputation.

  • structuralEqualityPolicy(): equivalent by == is not a change; common default.
  • referentialEqualityPolicy(): only a different reference counts; useful only when identity is the contract.
  • neverEqualPolicy(): every assignment counts as change; can increase invalidations and is not an event-delivery guarantee.

Choose a policy that matches semantic equality. snapshotFlow also observes snapshot reads but exports changes into Flow for effect/collection work; detailed keys, cancellation and side effects are reserved for Stage 15.

Identity, remembered-object lifecycle та disposal boundary#

Remembered values belong to a composition location. If the call leaves composition because a branch disappears, parent is removed, key changes, or host composition is disposed, its slots are forgotten and a later entry creates new values. Reordering unkeyed siblings can associate retained state with the wrong logical item; stable keys move identity with data. Runtime cleanup/disposal is tied to leaving composition, but imperative registration/unregistration belongs to effect APIs in Stage 15—not a remember initializer.

Compiler protocol, stability та non-Compose state interop#

The Compose compiler transforms composable calls to participate in a protocol conceptually involving a Composer, groups, changed metadata, restart scopes and skipping. Treat this as a mental model, not source/API contract: generated signatures and runtime representation may evolve. Stability helps the compiler/runtime reason about whether inputs may have changed and how comparison/skipping can work. @Stable/@Immutable are promises; annotation does not freeze a mutable object, observe hidden fields, or make mutable data safe. False promises can cause stale UI. Strong-skipping defaults and comparison behavior depend on compiler version; Stage 16 covers reports and performance.

Flow/StateFlow, LiveData, RxJava or custom observables are not automatically snapshot state. Adapt them to Compose State with lifecycle-aware integrations such as collectAsStateWithLifecycle, observeAsState, subscribeAsState, or a carefully implemented adapter. Collection lifetime, initial value, equality/conflation, thread and error semantics remain those of the source/integration.

Guarantees vs explicit non-guarantees#

Корисний contractНе гарантує
Observed snapshot reads establish dependencies; applied writes can invalidate observers.Every invalidation reruns the whole UI, or every intermediate write is rendered.
remember retains a slot while identity stays composed.Survival after leaving composition, recreation, or process death.
rememberSaveable integrates with SaveableStateRegistry.Durable storage; only Bundle-compatible/custom-saved minimal values are eligible.
Recomposition produces a new description.Execution at a fixed time/order: it may occur at any time, be skipped, coalesced or cancelled.
mutableStateOf observes writes to its value property.Observation of internal mutation in an arbitrary mutable object.
Stability metadata can enable reasoning/skipping.That a @Stable annotation makes mutable data immutable, observable or thread-safe.

Therefore composables must be idempotent and side-effect-free. derivedStateOf is not free, snapshot apply is not persistence, and a scheduled recomposition is not a delivery acknowledgement.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • Compose compiler plugin, Kotlin integration, strong-skipping defaults, stability inference, lambda memoization and generated protocol evolve. Pin Kotlin/Compose versions and inspect current release notes/compiler reports before a performance claim.
  • Runtime group/slot/snapshot implementation details may change. Rely on public observable contracts, not group counts, generated parameter layouts or slot-table shape as API.
  • Saveable types and registry integration depend on platform/host and library version. Verify custom Saver round trips and recreation on supported Android versions.
  • Snapshot APIs may carry experimental annotations or evolve conflict behavior; check the exact runtime API docs and never infer general thread safety from one successful test.

Decision framework#

  1. Назвіть fact and owner: UI element, shared UI behavior, screen/business state, or durable data.
  2. Choose observable representation: immutable value replacement, MutableState, snapshot list/map, or lifecycle-aware adapter from external observable state.
  3. Choose lifetime: local execution, composition identity, saveable recreation, ViewModel screen lifetime, or durable repository; save only minimum reconstruction input.
  4. Mark every snapshot read by phase and every mutable boundary. Ask whether hidden mutation bypasses both State setter and snapshot collection operation.
  5. Check identity under conditionals/reordering and choose stable keys; enumerate when remembered objects leave composition.
  6. Only then consider derivedStateOf, custom policy or phase deferral, with measurement and version-specific evidence deferred to Stage 16.

Trade-offs та failure modes#

  • Local state minimizes coupling, but duplicate owners diverge; over-hoisting creates broad APIs and needless invalidation.
  • Immutable replacement gives clear snapshots/equality but allocates; snapshot collections offer granular observable operations but expose mutable ownership and do not observe mutable element internals.
  • rememberSaveable improves recreation UX but Bundle size/schema and Saver bugs matter; saving complete models duplicates durable truth.
  • Structural equality suppresses equivalent assignments but expensive/broken equality hurts; referential policy misses in-place semantic changes; never-equal amplifies work.
  • Missing remember keys retain stale dependencies; excessive keys recreate holders and lose user state. Missing item keys transfer state across reordered data; unstable keys reset it.
  • Reading fast state in composition may broaden work; moving the read to draw cannot work when value changes structure or measurement.

Production scenario: reorderable product filters#

Гіпотетично: ViewModel exposes immutable products/filter results as StateFlow; route collects with collectAsStateWithLifecycle. Query that drives repository search belongs to ViewModel; expanded chip and transient draft selection stay at their lowest UI owner. A plain FilterPanelState coordinates expansion and selection, remembered by stable category ID. A Saver stores only selected IDs and query text, then reconstructs runtime objects.

@Composable
fun ProductRows(products: List<ProductUi>, onOpen: (String) -> Unit) {
    LazyColumn {
        items(products, key = { it.id }) { product ->
            var expanded by rememberSaveable(product.id) { mutableStateOf(false) }
            ProductRow(product, expanded, { expanded = !expanded }) { onOpen(product.id) }
        }
    }
}

Stable item key keeps the slot with product identity during sorting. The team uses mutableStateListOf only for UI-owned draft operations; repository results arrive as new immutable lists. A “show top” flag may use derivedStateOf { listState.firstVisibleItemIndex > 0 } because index changes more often than the Boolean. Scroll effects belong to Stage 15.

Code-review/debug trap#

@Stable
class CartUiState(val lines: MutableList<Line>) // false stability promise

@Composable fun Cart(state: CartUiState, currency: Currency) {
    val total = remember { state.lines.sumOf { it.price } } // stale: missing keys
    state.lines.add(promoLine)                              // hidden write in composition
    state.lines.forEachIndexed { index, line ->
        key(index) { EditableLine(line) }                   // identity follows position
    }
}

Symptoms: total is stale, mutation may not invalidate, recomposition can loop if another observed state is written, and editor state moves after insertion. Debug in order: identify owner/lifetime; log immutable state versions; find exact snapshot reads/writes and phase; verify setter/collection operation; inspect remember keys and sibling keys; remove false stability annotation. Fix with immutable replacement or snapshot collection under one owner, pure composition, remember(state.lines, currency) only if caching is justified, and key(line.id). Then reproduce reorder/recreation/process restoration; performance tooling waits for Stage 16.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. Що робить composition? Виконує composable calls, зіставляє groups/slots за identity і створює або оновлює UI description; initial composition будує topology, recomposition інкрементально переглядає invalidated scopes.
  2. Чи state write recomposes everything? Ні. Applied write invalidates observed scopes/phases; work may be coalesced, skipped or cancelled, а actual subtree залежить від reads, restart scopes і parameter changes.
  3. Що гарантує remember? Positional retention, доки та сама identity лишається у composition. Не recreation, не leaving composition і не process death.
  4. Чому mutableStateOf(mutableListOf()) може не оновити UI? add mutates internals без State setter. Замініть immutable list або використайте snapshot state list.
  5. Коли потрібен rememberSaveable? Для мінімального UI element state, який має відновитися через registry після recreation/process recreation; це не durable storage.
  6. Коли потрібен derivedStateOf? Коли dependencies змінюються частіше, ніж meaningful derived result; не для кожного expression і не без cost.
  7. Як працює identity в reordered list? Call-site position є default; stable unique item key переносить remembered state з logical item, тоді як index може прив’язати його до позиції.
  8. Що дає mutation policy? Визначає, чи assignment вважається зміною: structural, referential або always changed; це не робить hidden mutation observable.
  9. Чи @Stable робить клас safe? Ні. Це semantic promise runtime/compiler; усі observable mutations мають лишатися observable, а hidden mutable fields роблять promise false.
  10. Як інтегрувати StateFlow/LiveData? Перетворити на Compose State через lifecycle-aware adapter і зберегти source semantics щодо initial value, lifetime, errors та equality.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Background threads simultaneously edit snapshot state. Define owner and mutable snapshot boundaries; apply explicitly, handle conflicts/retry, and do not mix unsynchronized ordinary mutable fields. Validate against the exact runtime version.
  2. Rows retain wrong text after sorting. Positional identity followed index. Use stable unique business keys and ensure nested remembers are inside that keyed identity.
  3. Saved state exceeds limits. Persist durable model in repository; Saver stores IDs/query/position needed to reconstruct. Test registry restoration and schema fallback.
  4. A draw-only animation causes recomposition. Find where the state is actually read. If structure is constant, defer read to draw/placement API; if measurement/structure depends on it, that earlier phase is correct.

4 unanswered self-checks#

  1. Для кожного mutable value на вашому screen: хто owner, який observable write path і який lifetime?
  2. Які remembered values можуть отримати stale dependencies або перейти до іншого item після reorder?
  3. Які reads відбуваються в composition, measure/place і draw, та яка найраніша правильна phase?
  4. Що реально відновиться після branch removal, Activity recreation і process death, а що реконструюється з durable truth?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How does Compose runtime state drive recomposition, and how do you choose state ownership and retention?

~30-second answer#

Compose is an incremental runtime. The compiler makes composable calls participate in groups and restart scopes, while the slot table retains values by call-site identity. Snapshot reads register dependencies; applied writes invalidate the scopes or phases that observed them, but work can be coalesced, skipped, or cancelled. I use observable immutable replacement or snapshot collections, hoist to the lowest owner, use remember only for composition lifetime, and rememberSaveable only for minimal registry-saveable reconstruction data. Stable item keys preserve identity. Composables remain idempotent and side-effect-free.

~2-minute answer#

I model Compose as incremental tree construction and update. The compiler transforms composable calls into a runtime protocol conceptually involving a Composer, groups, change metadata, restart scopes, and skipping. The slot table stores group structure and remembered values by positional call-site identity. Initial composition creates that topology; recomposition revisits invalidated scopes. A stable explicit key is essential when conditional or reordered content must retain logical item identity.

Snapshot state records reads and writes. An applied write invalidates observers that read the changed value. That is not a promise that the whole tree reruns: invalidations can be coalesced, groups can be skipped, and work can be cancelled. Mutable snapshots isolate changes until apply and concurrent writes can conflict, so low-level users need explicit apply, conflict, and thread ownership rules. Ordinary mutable fields and a MutableList inside mutableStateOf are not observed when mutated internally.

I separate composition, layout, and draw reads because invalidation can restart only the relevant later phase. I author local state with remember plus mutableStateOf, or snapshot lists/maps, and replace immutable values at ownership boundaries. Missing remember keys create stale caches; volatile keys recreate state. I hoist only to the lowest common owner, extract a plain state holder for cohesive UI logic, and keep business/durable state in a ViewModel and repository.

Remember survives only while its identity remains composed. RememberSaveable uses the SaveableStateRegistry and Bundle-compatible or custom-Saver values; it is not durable storage. A Saver stores minimal IDs or input needed to rebuild objects. derivedStateOf is justified when dependencies change more often than the meaningful result, and it has overhead. Mutation policy must match semantic equality. Compiler stability and skipping behavior are version-sensitive, and Stable is a promise—not a mechanism that makes mutable data safe. Therefore composables are idempotent and side-effect-free; effects belong to the next stage and deep profiling to Stage 16.

Compose effects, navigation та ViewModel integrationрозгорнути / згорнути

Learning objective#

Після етапу ви маєте тримати composable body pure та idempotent; вибирати effect API за lifecycle роботи; проєктувати semantic keys, cancellation, cleanup і stale-capture policy; інтегрувати lifecycle-aware state, stateless content, ViewModel та Navigation Compose; моделювати back stack, deep links і transient UI actions без неправдивої exactly-once обіцянки; та тестувати boundaries окремо. Stage 10 вже пояснює event primitives, Stage 12 — architecture/state ownership, Stage 14 — runtime, а Stage 17 — повну DI; тут лише їх Compose wiring.

Senior mental model#

Composition описує бажаний UI; effect прив’язує imperative work до конкретного composition identity/lifecycle; ViewModel володіє screen state; NavController володіє UI back stack, але не domain truth. Composable body може rerun, skip або бути abandoned до commit, тому зовнішня дія в body некоректна. Effect стартує тільки після успішного входу instance у composition, а key визначає restart identity, не business exactly-once.

  • Розділяйте composition-driven synchronization, user-event work і durable business transition: це три різні trigger/lifetime/delivery contracts.
  • Малюйте topology: producer → lifecycle gate → route/state holder → stateless content; окремо effect source → collector → UI imperative target; окремо NavController/back stack.
  • Cancellation зупиняє cooperative coroutine, але не відкочує вже відправлений HTTP request, payment або запис зовнішньої системи.

Effects, navigation та ViewModel internals/topology#

repository/domain truth → ViewModel-owned StateFlow
    → collectAsStateWithLifecycle() in Route
    → immutable UiState + callbacks → stateless Content

composition identity + effect keys → effect instance/job/cleanup
user callback → rememberCoroutineScope job (UI-owned)

NavHost graph ↔ NavController ↔ back-stack entries
                               ↳ destination/graph ViewModelStoreOwner
deep link → parse + validate/authorize ID → repository truth

NavHost materializes destinations from a graph against a NavController. Each back-stack entry can provide lifecycle, saved state and a ViewModelStoreOwner; popping an owner clears its scoped ViewModels. A nested graph entry can share one ViewModel across child destinations; Activity ownership intentionally outlives all destinations. Choose the narrowest owner that must share the state, and never use wider scope merely to avoid passing a contract.

Effect API selection та lifecycle#

APIПравильний contractТипова пастка
SideEffectPublish Compose state до non-Compose object після кожної успішної recomposition.Використати для one-shot analytics: отримаєте повтори.
LaunchedEffect(keys)Composition-driven suspend work; job cancel/restart, коли instance leaves composition або key змінюється.Unit із changing input або broad/volatile key.
DisposableEffect(keys)Paired register/unregister; onDispose при key/instance removal.Вважати cleanup process-shutdown hook.
rememberCoroutineScope()Launch suspend UI work із click/gesture callback; scope скасовується, коли owner leaves composition.Створити event flag лише для запуску LaunchedEffect.
rememberUpdatedState(value)Long-lived effect не restart-иться, але callback/value читається latest у deferred execution.Ховати input, зміна якого повинна restart-нути work.
produceStateАдаптувати suspend/callback source до Compose State; producer cancel-иться з keys/instance, values conflate.Дублювати repository/ViewModel state або забути awaitDispose для callback.
snapshotFlowПеретворити snapshot reads на cold Flow всередині coroutine.Очікувати emission кожного write або будувати chain без terminal collection.

Abandoned composition не повинна залишити зовнішній effect: body ще не є committed lifecycle. DisposableEffect setup/cleanup і post-commit SideEffect існують саме для межі успішної composition. Але crash/process kill може не дати виконати cleanup, тому correctness зовнішньої системи не може залежати лише від onDispose.

Semantic keys, stale capture та snapshotFlow topology#

@Composable
fun SearchRoute(queryId: String, onExpired: () -> Unit) {
    val latestOnExpired by rememberUpdatedState(onExpired)
    LaunchedEffect(queryId) {              // identity follows the query
        delay(30_000)
        latestOnExpired()                  // latest callback; no timer restart
    }
}

LaunchedEffect(listState) {
    snapshotFlow { listState.firstVisibleItemIndex }
        .map { it > 0 }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .collectLatest { visible -> analytics.setScrolled(visible) }
}
  • Key — semantic identity залежності: userId, queryId, lifecycleOwner. Key change спершу cancel/dispose old instance, потім запускає new; cancellation cooperative.
  • rememberUpdatedState потрібен, коли effect lifetime не змінюється, але delayed callback має бути latest. Якщо userId змінює source/lifetime, він має бути key.
  • snapshotFlow records snapshot reads під час block, re-runs після relevant applied change і emits unequal result (подібно до distinctUntilChanged). Це observation, не audit log: intermediate/equal values можуть не з’явитися.
  • Backpressure topology залишається Flow topology: debounce, buffer, conflate, collectLatest свідомо змінюють latency, cancellation і loss. Slow analytics collector без operator може suspend observation; external exactly-once не виникає.

Lifecycle-aware collection та duplicated collectors#

Android route зазвичай читає render state через collectAsStateWithLifecycle(); underlying collection active лише на заданому minimum lifecycle і може unsubscribe/re-subscribe. Це економить work, але cold upstream може restart-нути, replay/current state може бути read знову, а transient emission під час неактивності може загубитися. Для platform-neutral Compose використовуйте відповідний collectAsState contract. Не запускайте паралельно два collectors одного UI effect у route і Activity: lifecycle re-entry або duplicate composition створить дублікати.

Lifecycle collection не є acknowledgement. Якщо payment завершився, durable order/payment status має жити в repository/state і після resubscription визначати UI; snackbar про completion може бути best-effort. SharedFlow/Channel — in-memory coordination, не durable exactly-once queue.

Stateless content + route/state-holder wiring#

@Composable
fun CheckoutRoute(
    onReceipt: (String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    CheckoutContent(
        state = state,
        onPay = viewModel::pay,
        onReceipt = { onReceipt(state.orderId) },
    )
}

@Composable
fun CheckoutContent(
    state: CheckoutUiState,
    onPay: () -> Unit,
    onReceipt: () -> Unit,
) { /* layout only; preview/test with plain values */ }

Route отримує ViewModel/controller, collect-ить state та перетворює navigation у callbacks. Content приймає immutable UI contract і user-event lambdas; він не знає про DI, repositories, NavController або lifecycle. Не передавайте controller глибоко: onProductClick(id) легше тестувати й перевикористовувати.

ViewModel ownership, factories та scoping#

  • Destination-scoped ViewModel живе, доки відповідний back-stack entry у stack. Graph-scoped ділить flow state між destinations nested graph. Activity-scoped переживає destination pop і підходить лише для справді Activity-wide state.
  • viewModel() використовує найближчий ViewModelStoreOwner; для parent graph явно отримайте stable parent entry через getBackStackEntry(graphRoute) і використайте його owner. Scope choice має бути видимою design decision.
  • ViewModel survives configuration change, але не process death. Після recreation новий instance реконструюється з minimal saved input та durable repository truth.
  • Constructor dependencies створюються через ViewModelProvider.Factory/CreationExtras; createSavedStateHandle() бере handle із extras. Hilt може згенерувати factory та надати hiltViewModel(). Тут важливий owner/extras boundary, не container setup Stage 17.

SavedStateHandle, arguments та recreation boundaries#

SavedStateHandle — key/value state для ViewModel recreation, не durable business storage. Navigation arguments можуть бути доступні через handle; type-safe routes можуть decode через toRoute<T>() у сумісних версіях. Передавайте stable identifier/primitives (productId, orderId), а не domain object: destination заново читає авторитетну модель з repository. Після process death server/database могла змінитися, argument міг бути відсутній/старий, тому parse, validate і handle not-found.

Navigation graph, type-safe routes та back-stack policy#

@Serializable data object Home
@Serializable data class Receipt(val orderId: String)

NavHost(navController, startDestination = Home) {
    composable<Home> { HomeRoute(onReceipt = { navController.navigate(Receipt(it)) }) }
    composable<Receipt> { entry ->
        val route = entry.toRoute<Receipt>()
        ReceiptRoute(orderId = route.orderId)
    }
}

navController.navigate(Home) {
    popUpTo(navController.graph.findStartDestination().id) { saveState = true }
    launchSingleTop = true
    restoreState = true
}
  • popUpTo removes entries up to target; inclusive = true removes target too. Wrong target/inclusive can erase expected Back history.
  • launchSingleTop avoids another copy only when target is already on top; it is not global deduplication.
  • saveState/restoreState can preserve/restore navigator destination state for tab-like flows. Multiple back stacks require deliberate top-level destination policy, stable routes and tests; they are not domain persistence.
  • Deep links are untrusted input. Restrict scheme/host/path, decode safely, validate format/range, authorize access, and load by ID. A valid route does not grant domain permission.

Navigation/UI actions vs durable outcomes#

Direct click navigation is a UI action: callback can call navigator once for that click. Composition-driven navigation needs explicit consumption/idempotency semantics; if (state.paid) navController.navigate(...) у body або naive LaunchedEffect(state.paid) може повторитися після recreation/resubscription. Key controls restart, not “handled once forever”.

ФактМодельTrade-off
Payment/order completedDurable repository status + idempotent command/request ID.Survives process death; UI derives next safe screen, але transition policy must avoid loops.
Navigate after clickUI callback/navigator contract.Simple; protect against double tap and define stack options.
SnackbarBest-effort UI effect, or render durable message state with explicit acknowledgement if loss is unacceptable.SharedFlow/Channel can lose or duplicate around lifecycle/process boundaries.

Не перетворюйте NavController destination на source of truth для payment/auth. Domain outcome authoritatively exists outside navigation; route selection is a projection. Якщо effect stream використовується, документуйте loss, replay, duplicate collection і acknowledgement policy без claims про durable exactly-once.

Guarantees vs explicit non-guarantees#

Корисний contractНе гарантує
LaunchedEffect job cancel-иться при key/instance removal.Preemption non-cooperative code, rollback external effects або exactly-once execution.
Effect key задає restart identity.Одне виконання за process/session/business operation.
rememberCoroutineScope cancel-иться, коли owner leaves composition.Завершення job після navigation away або durable business delivery.
DisposableEffect.onDispose викликається, коли key/instance leaves composition.Process-crash/shutdown cleanup guarantee.
ViewModel зберігається через configuration change свого owner.Survival after process death або після clear owner-а.
SavedStateHandle допомагає recreation.Durable/large/authoritative business storage.
Lifecycle-aware collector stop/start-иться з lifecycle.Безперервна subscription або delivery emissions під час inactivity.
SharedFlow/Channel координують in-memory consumers.Durable exactly-once queue.
NavController керує UI stack.Domain source of truth.

Version-sensitive behavior#

  • Generic type-safe Navigation Compose routes (composable<T>, object/data-class routes, toRoute<T>, typed navigate/popUpTo) are Navigation 2.8-era APIs and evolve with Navigation/Kotlin serialization. Pin artifacts/plugin, read current release notes and do not present legacy string-route examples as identical.
  • Navigation 3 is a separate, evolving Compose-first library with different back-stack ownership/API; do not mix its contracts with Navigation 2 examples.
  • collectAsStateWithLifecycle comes from androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-compose; overloads, minimum lifecycle constraints and platform availability depend on Lifecycle version. Compose Multiplatform may use another collector.
  • viewModel(), hiltViewModel(), CreationExtras/default factory and SavedState integration depend on Activity/Lifecycle/Navigation/Hilt versions. Verify owner and factory in the pinned dependency graph.
  • Effect semantics must follow current Compose runtime docs; implementation scheduling is not a public exactly-once protocol.

Decision framework#

  1. Назвіть trigger: successful composition, key identity, user event, lifecycle visibility чи durable domain transition.
  2. Назвіть owner/lifetime: composition instance, destination, nested graph, Activity, ViewModel чи repository.
  3. Оберіть найвужчий API: body для description; SideEffect publish; DisposableEffect pair; LaunchedEffect keyed suspend; remembered scope для callback; produceState adapter; snapshotFlow snapshot observation.
  4. Запишіть semantic keys, stale-value policy, cooperative cancellation points, cleanup і external idempotency.
  5. Для state оберіть lifecycle collector; для event/action запишіть loss/duplicate/replay/acknowledgement semantics.
  6. Для navigation визначте route ID validation, owner scope, stack transform, deep-link trust boundary і post-process-death reconstruction.
  7. Тестуйте pure content, effect contract, ViewModel reducer/recreation і graph/back stack на відповідному boundary.

Trade-offs та failure modes#

  • Надто broad key restart-ить дорогий collector; constant key stale-capture-ить dependency; random key руйнує lifecycle.
  • rememberUpdatedState зберігає latest callback без restart, але приховує bug, якщо source мав змінитися.
  • collectLatest зменшує lag, скасовуючи previous handling; для non-idempotent external write це може залишити partial effect.
  • Activity-scoped ViewModel полегшує sharing, але створює stale cross-screen state і не clear-иться після graph exit.
  • Передача domain object route-ом дає stale/oversized/serialization-coupled snapshot; ID вимагає reload, зате зберігає truth та authorization.
  • launchSingleTop і multiple-stack restore покращують tabs, але неправильний popUpTo губить history або накопичує duplicate entries.
  • Lifecycle resubscription може restart-нути cold upstream; duplicated route/effect collectors можуть двічі показати snackbar або navigate.

Production scenario: payment completion#

Гіпотетично: user натискає Pay; ViewModel надсилає command з idempotency key, repository persist-ить order/payment status, а StateFlow показує Processing/Completed. Route collect-ить через collectAsStateWithLifecycle; stateless content лише викликає onPay. Навігація до Receipt(orderId) — UI policy з guard/consumption, а receipt screen reload-ить order за ID. Після process death app читає durable Completed і безпечно вирішує destination; SharedFlow completion не є єдиним доказом.

Snackbar “Payment complete” best-effort: вона може загубитися при background або повторитися після collector restart. Якщо повідомлення юридично/операційно важливе, це acknowledged durable notification state, не ephemeral snackbar. Bottom tabs використовують popUpTo(start) { saveState = true }, launchSingleTop, restoreState; deep-linked orderId format-check-иться й authorize-иться до показу.

Code-review/debug trap#

@Composable
fun Checkout(vm: CheckoutViewModel, nav: NavController) {
    val state by vm.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    if (state.paid) nav.navigate("receipt/${state.order}") // side effect in body
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { vm.events.collect { nav.navigate(it.route) } }
    DisposableEffect(Unit) {
        gateway.addListener { vm.refresh() }
        onDispose { } // leaked listener
    }
}

Trap: body navigation can run repeatedly; Unit collector may retain wrong VM/nav owner and duplicate with another collector; domain object/string route is stale/untrusted; listener lacks symmetric removal. Debug with effect-instance logs (key, owner, start/cancel/dispose), back-stack snapshots, collector counts and process/lifecycle recreation. Fix: route/content split, typed route with stable orderId, direct click callback or explicit outcome consumption, semantic keys/latest callbacks, paired cleanup, durable payment truth and idempotent command.

Testing effects, navigation та ViewModel boundaries#

  • Pure Compose tests render Content(state, callbacks) and assert semantics/callback IDs without real ViewModel/NavController.
  • Effect tests control keys and composition presence: assert restart cancellation, latest callback, listener registration/removal and no body side effect; use deterministic coroutine time where applicable.
  • ViewModel unit tests assert state transitions, idempotency/retry and reconstruction from minimal SavedStateHandle; do not infer process-death safety from configuration-change tests.
  • Graph integration can use TestNavHostController plus ComposeNavigator to verify start destination, typed destination/back stack, popUpTo and restore policy. Prefer a small Navigator contract fake for route callback tests; test deep-link validation/authorization separately.

10 likely practice Q&A#

Це likely practice questions, не підтверджений і не гарантований список співбесіди.

  1. Чому не можна запускати effect у composable body? Body може rerun, skip або бути abandoned; external work не має committed lifecycle. Оберіть post-commit/keyed effect або user callback.
  2. Як вибрати LaunchedEffect key? Key має бути semantic identity source/work. Його зміна означає cancel old і start new, але не exactly-once.
  3. LaunchedEffect чи rememberCoroutineScope? Перший — composition-driven keyed lifecycle; другий — suspend work із click/gesture callback, cancelled із owner.
  4. Коли rememberUpdatedState? Коли long-lived effect не повинен restart, але delayed callback/value має бути latest; не для source identity.
  5. Що гарантує DisposableEffect? Paired disposal при key/instance removal; не cleanup після process kill.
  6. Що робить snapshotFlow? Спостерігає snapshot reads і emits unequal results у cold Flow; це не журнал кожного write, а downstream operators визначають backpressure/loss.
  7. Як scope-ити ViewModel? До narrowest ViewModelStoreOwner: destination, shared nested graph або справді Activity-wide owner; pop owner-а clear-ить instance.
  8. Що зберігати у route/SavedStateHandle? Мінімальні stable IDs/primitives для reconstruction; не domain objects і не durable truth.
  9. Чи SharedFlow гарантує navigation once? Ні. Lifecycle/process gaps і duplicate collectors дають loss/duplication; durable outcomes моделюйте state + idempotent policy.
  10. Як тестувати Navigation Compose? Content тестуйте callbacks; graph — TestNavHostController/ComposeNavigator або contract fake, перевіряючи destination і stack options.

4 senior follow-ups з відповідями#

  1. Effect cancel-ився після HTTP submit. Cancellation не undo-ить server side effect. Використайте idempotency key, query durable result і reconcile unknown outcome.
  2. Bottom-tab state інколи зникає. Перевірте однаковий top-level route, popUpTo(findStartDestination()), paired saveState/restoreState, singleTop і navigator/version-specific restoration tests.
  3. Graph-shared ViewModel створюється двічі. Обидва destinations мають явно використовувати той самий parent graph back-stack entry як owner; логувати owner/entry lifecycle, не лише class name.
  4. Completion navigate дублюється після rotation. Не робіть boolean state одноразовою командою. Durable completion лишається state; navigation policy має guard/acknowledgement/idempotent stack transform і тест recreation.

4 unanswered self-checks#

  1. Для кожного effect: який trigger, semantic key, cancellation point, stale-capture policy і cleanup?
  2. Що станеться з кожним state/effect collector при STOP→START, destination duplicate, pop і process death?
  3. Який exact owner має кожний ViewModel, коли він clear-иться, і що реконструює його після process recreation?
  4. Які navigation inputs untrusted, яка back-stack transform очікується і де живе durable domain truth?

Interview-ready English answer skeletons#

Question: How do you integrate Compose effects, Navigation, and ViewModels without duplicate work or lost outcomes?

~30-second answer#

I keep composable bodies pure and choose an effect by ownership: SideEffect for post-commit publishing, DisposableEffect for paired registration, LaunchedEffect for composition-driven keyed work, and a remembered scope for user events. Keys define restart identity, not exactly-once delivery, and cancellation cannot undo external effects. A route collects ViewModel state with lifecycle awareness and passes immutable state and callbacks to stateless content. I scope ViewModels to the narrowest destination, graph, or Activity owner, pass stable IDs through typed routes, treat deep links as untrusted, and keep durable outcomes in repositories rather than SharedFlow, SavedStateHandle, or NavController.

~2-minute answer#

My starting rule is that composition describes UI and can rerun, skip, or be abandoned, so it cannot perform external work. I use SideEffect to publish after successful recomposition, DisposableEffect for symmetric setup and cleanup, LaunchedEffect for suspend work whose lifetime follows semantic keys, and rememberCoroutineScope when a click starts UI-owned suspend work. rememberUpdatedState keeps a callback fresh without restarting a long-lived effect; produceState adapts an external producer to State; snapshotFlow observes snapshot reads as a cold Flow. Effect cancellation is cooperative, disposal is not a process-shutdown hook, and no key gives business exactly-once.

On Android, the route layer collects StateFlow with collectAsStateWithLifecycle and passes plain immutable state and callbacks to stateless content. Collection can stop and restart with lifecycle, so cold upstreams may restart and transient emissions may be lost. I avoid duplicate collectors and treat SharedFlow or Channel as in-memory delivery, not durable queues. A completed payment or order is repository state with idempotent commands; a snackbar is usually best-effort.

I scope a ViewModel to the narrowest ViewModelStoreOwner: a destination by default, a nested graph for intentional sharing, or the Activity only for Activity-wide state. It survives configuration change, not process death. Factories and CreationExtras reconstruct dependencies and SavedStateHandle; Hilt can generate that wiring, but scope remains an explicit decision. SavedStateHandle stores minimal restorable input, not authoritative business data.

Navigation Compose owns a UI graph and back stack. I prefer version-compatible typed serializable routes, pass stable IDs rather than objects, validate and authorize deep links, and reload truth from a repository. I specify popUpTo and inclusive carefully; launchSingleTop only deduplicates the top; saveState and restoreState support deliberate multiple-back-stack policies. NavController is never my domain source of truth. I test pure content with callbacks, ViewModel state and recreation separately, effects by key/disposal, and graph behavior with TestNavHostController or a navigator contract fake.
